requires: Sorcerer level 5, Divine Soul subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire a dying pilgrim begs for a blessing; heal them with sorcery until you have no spell slots left, then carry them to the top floor.
secret: The pilgrim is your celestial ancestor in disguise, and the job only triggers if you never once ask their name.
notice: [Hidden job change. The blood remembers where it came from. Halo kindled.]
blurb: A Divine Soul who stops treating the celestial blood as a footnote and lets it shine, a faint halo marking every spell.
features: Skill: Borrowed Halo
When you cast a healing spell, one creature you heal also gains +1 AC until the start of your next turn.
Skill: Ancestor's Nudge
Twice per long rest, add 1d6 to an ally's failed save or attack roll after seeing the result.
Ultimate: Dawn of the Bloodline
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your halo sheds bright light; allies in it regain 1d8 hit points at the start of each of their turns and fiends in it have disadvantage on attacks.
evolves: At level 21, if you have saved 100 lives with healing, the halo hardens into a crown that can be offered to a Heaven god for a contract.
cost: Undead and fiends can see your halo through walls and across a mile of dark.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Divine Soul subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: On the 12th floor of the Fogglass Spire, forge a pair of metal wings from a fallen angel's broken halo using only the forge fire of your own spells.
secret: The forge only takes your spells as fuel if every hammer stroke is timed to a heartbeat you count aloud.
notice: [Hidden job change. Metal answers to holy blood. You may now forge feathers.]
blurb: Smith and sorcerer at once, this Divine Soul hammers celestial power into gear: feathered blades, haloed shields and wings of beaten light.
features: Skill: Feather-Tempered
Weapons and armor you forge may hold one cantrip or 1st level spell from your list, cast once per long rest by the wielder.
Skill: Beaten Wings
Your forged wings give a flying speed of 30 feet while you are not wearing heavy armor.
Ultimate: Anvil of Dawn
Once per long rest, slam a forged item down to unleash radiant shards in a 30 foot cone (8d8 radiant, Dexterity save for half).
evolves: Forge a full set of feathered armor from Heaven grade metal to evolve into a smith the Choir Spire will commission.
cost: Every item you forge carries a drop of your blood, and breaking one costs you 1d10 hit points.

requires: Sorcerer level 21, Divine Soul subclass; Minor contract with Amaterasu or Ra
unlock: Climb to floor 23 of the Choir Spire and sing with the choir for a full day without missing a note, then let a sun god speak one sentence through your mouth.
secret: The contract only seals if you have never cast a spell to deceive anyone since reaching level 11.
notice: [Hidden job change. A god has rented your voice. The sun sings through you.]
blurb: A Divine Soul who becomes a living speaking-tube for a sun god, trading some freedom for blazing borrowed authority.
features: Skill: Sun-Spoken
Your radiant spells ignore resistance to radiant damage and treat immunity as resistance.
Skill: The Choir Answers
As a reaction when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, they instead drop to 1 and you take the damage they would have taken over that.
Ultimate: Noon Without End
Once per long rest, call noon for 1 minute in a 120 foot radius: darkness and invisibility end, and your spells in it deal an extra 4d6 radiant.
evolves: Hold the contract for 10 years without breaking a divine command and it may rise to a 3rd Finger contract.
cost: The god may speak through you at any time, including in the middle of a lie or a prayer to someone else.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Draconic Bloodline subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire a dragon's empty nest holds one egg; sleep curled around it for three nights and let it hatch on your chest.
secret: The egg only hatches if you are carrying at least 500 gold worth of treasure you refuse to spend.
notice: [Hidden job change. The hoard knows its keeper. Your scales go deeper.]
blurb: A draconic sorcerer whose ancestry stops being a colour and becomes an instinct: hoarding, guarding and breathing the old fire.
features: Skill: Hoard Scales
While you carry treasure worth 1000 gold or more, you gain +1 AC and resistance to your ancestry's damage type.
Skill: Ancestral Breath
As an action, exhale a 30 foot cone of your ancestry's damage type (6d6, Dexterity save for half), once per short rest.
Ultimate: Wings of the First Clutch
Once per long rest, for 10 minutes you sprout wings (flying speed 60 feet) and your breath recharges on a 5 or 6 each turn.
evolves: At level 15, if your hoard ever reaches 10000 gold, your hatchling grows into a mount that can share your breath.
cost: Losing more than half your hoard leaves you shaking with dragon greed for a week (disadvantage on Wisdom saves).

requires: Sorcerer level 31, Draconic Bloodline subclass; carries a fragment of any elemental Rune
unlock: On floor 33 of the Shuffled Spire the floors shuffle into a dragon's spine; ride it through every reshuffle until it bows and swallows your Rune fragment.
secret: The spine only bows if your ancestry's element differs from the Rune fragment you carry.
notice: [Hidden job change. Two elements share one blood. The Rune has learned to roar.]
blurb: A draconic sorcerer whose blood braids with a Rune fragment, letting the ancestral breath change element at will.
features: Skill: Braided Element
Whenever you deal your ancestry's damage type, you may change it to the Rune fragment's element instead, and the target loses resistance to it until your next turn.
Skill: Rune-Scored Hide
When an enemy hits you with damage of either of your elements, reduce it by your Charisma modifier plus your proficiency bonus.
Ultimate: Twin-Throat Storm
Once per long rest, breathe both elements in a 90 foot line (14d10 split between them, Dexterity save for half).
evolves: Claim a whole minor Rune instead of a fragment and the herald may seek the progenitor dragon's trail.
cost: Each use of the Rune breath scars your throat; you cannot speak above a whisper for an hour afterward.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Draconic Bloodline subclass; Cooking profession level 4
unlock: On the 11th floor of the Fogglass Spire, cook a feast for a starving wyvern using only ingredients you hunt within the mist, and eat from the same plate.
secret: The wyvern only shares the plate if the dish contains something from your ancestry's element (a fire pepper, frost moss, and so on).
notice: [Hidden job change. The hearth is a dragon's mouth. Your cooking breathes.]
blurb: A draconic sorcerer who learns that dragons are what they eat, and cooks meals that wake the bloodline in anyone who tastes them.
features: Skill: Ember Supper
After a short rest meal you cook, up to six eaters gain resistance to your ancestry's damage type for 8 hours.
Skill: Marrow Broth
Spend 1 hour and 1 sorcery point per eater: each gains temporary hit points equal to your Sorcerer level.
Ultimate: Feast of the Wyrm
Once per long rest, a meal you serve lets every eater breathe a 15 foot cone of your element (5d8, Dexterity save for half) once in the next 24 hours.
evolves: Cook a meal from a true dragon's heart to evolve into a chef whose feasts can temporarily grant scales.
cost: You can no longer taste food you did not cook yourself.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Dragonblood subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire, stand inside a ring of braziers and let your heart slow to a dragon's pace, one beat a minute, for an hour.
secret: The job only triggers if you entered the tower having taken damage from your own spell at least once.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your heart has slowed. The dragon in you is awake.]
blurb: A Dragonblood sorcerer who learns to pace the blood like a coiled serpent, saving its heat for one devastating release.
features: Skill: Banked Heat
Each turn you do not cast a leveled spell, gain 1 Coil (max 5). Spend Coils to add 1d6 per Coil to your next spell's damage.
Skill: Serpent's Patience
While you have 3 or more Coils you gain +1 AC and advantage on concentration saves.
Ultimate: Uncoiling
Once per long rest, spend 5 Coils to cast a leveled spell twice in one action at different targets.
evolves: At level 15, release five full Coils in a single fight 50 times and the pulse evolves into a sorcerer who can store heat between days.
cost: Your heartbeat is so slow that healers find you hard to read; healing spells on you heal 2 less per die.

requires: Sorcerer level 21, Dragonblood subclass
unlock: In the Ledger Spire, floor 22, find the plaque of an unpaid dragon debt and pay it with a pint of your blood and a promise to burn the debtor's hoard.
secret: The plaque only accepts the payment if you have previously refused a devil's offer to purify your blood.
notice: [Hidden job change. A dead wyrm's debt is now yours. Hell has signed the receipt.]
blurb: A Dragonblood sorcerer who inherits a fallen black wyrm's grudge along with its acid-dark blood.
features: Skill: Acid Ledger
Mark one creature per day; your spells deal an extra 2d6 acid to it, and the marked creature cannot regain hit points while the acid burns.
Skill: Debt of Scales
When you take damage, you may store it as Debt (up to your Sorcerer level) and add it to your next spell's damage.
Ultimate: Collection Day
Once per long rest, every marked creature you have ever damaged within 300 feet takes 10d8 acid damage (Constitution save for half).
evolves: Burn the debtor's hoard to ash and the black wyrm's ghost offers to make you its heir.
cost: Devils in the Ledger Spire treat you as a debtor and may demand interest in blood.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Dragonblood subclass; Carving profession level 4
unlock: On the 12th floor of the Fogglass Spire, carve a dragon's fang into a focus while your own reflection tries to stop you from finishing.
secret: The reflection only lets you finish if you carve your own true name inside the hollow of the fang.
notice: [Hidden job change. Fang and blood agree. Your focus has teeth.]
blurb: A Dragonblood sorcerer who carves foci from dragon remains, each one a little storehouse of the blood's fury.
features: Skill: Fanged Focus
A fang focus you carve adds its material's Potency to one damage roll per spell.
Skill: Scale Lattice
Carve scale charms; up to three allies wearing one gain +1 AC against breath weapons and elemental spells.
Ultimate: Bone-Choir of Dragons
Once per long rest, every carved fang within 60 feet shrieks at once, dealing 6d10 thunder to each enemy near one (Constitution save for half).
evolves: Carve a focus from an Abyss grade dragon bone to evolve into a carver whose foci can speak.
cost: Dragons smell your work on you and will not parley with you.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Gnome Bloodline subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, bury yourself to the neck in the tower's soil for a night and listen until the dead spirit Gnome hums back.
secret: The hum only comes if you have never once struck stone in anger.
notice: [Hidden job change. The earth hums your name. Your roots go down.]
blurb: A Gnome Bloodline sorcerer who stops borrowing stone and starts belonging to it, slow, heavy and nearly impossible to move.
features: Skill: Rooted Stance
While you have not moved this turn, you cannot be pushed, pulled or knocked prone, and gain +1 AC.
Skill: Bedrock Echo
Once per turn when you cast a spell while rooted, creatures you choose within 10 feet take 1d8 bludgeoning as the ground jolts.
Ultimate: Gnome's Last Sigh
Once per long rest, the ground in a 30 foot radius rises into a stone wall ring you control for 1 minute; you may reshape it as a bonus action.
evolves: At level 15, if you have spent 100 nights sleeping on bare earth, the heir evolves into a sorcerer the land itself defends.
cost: Moving more than 30 feet in a turn makes you dizzy and costs you your reaction.

requires: Sorcerer level 41, Gnome Bloodline subclass; has visited the place Gnome died
unlock: Descend to floor 44 of the Sunken Spire and dig the dead spirit Gnome a proper grave, then climb out without breaking the earth you filled.
secret: The grave only counts if you buried something you love alongside Gnome's dust.
notice: [Hidden job change. A dead spirit has been mourned. The earth grieves through you.]
blurb: A Gnome Bloodline sorcerer who turns the spirit's death into power, wielding the grief of buried stone.
features: Skill: Burial Weight
Your earth spells reduce the target's speed to 0 until the end of its next turn and deal extra bludgeoning equal to your Charisma modifier times 2.
Skill: Mourner's Mantle
When an ally within 30 feet would die, you may bury them in stone instead: they are stable, unconscious and immune to damage for 1 minute.
Ultimate: The Earth Keeps Everything
Once per long rest, the ground in a 60 foot radius swallows enemies to the waist (Strength save); swallowed enemies take 12d10 bludgeoning each round they stay.
evolves: Find and wake a living fragment of Gnome to evolve into a sorcerer who carries the spirit's second life.
cost: Flowers die where you sleep, and rain will not fall on you.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Gnome Bloodline subclass; Harvesting profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, mine a vein of ore that only exists while you hum to it, and bring out a full sack before the mist closes it.
secret: The vein only stays open if you leave half the ore behind as an offering.
notice: [Hidden job change. The stone shows you its veins. Your blood is a dowsing rod.]
blurb: A Gnome Bloodline sorcerer who uses the spirit's sense for buried things to find, pull and sell the earth's treasures.
features: Skill: Ore-Sense
You know the direction and grade of every ore or gem deposit within 300 feet; Harvesting checks for stone and ore gain your Charisma modifier.
Skill: Stone Pull
As an action, draw up to 50 pounds of ore from rock within 60 feet, or rip a creature's metal armor half off (lose 2 AC until repaired, Strength save).
Ultimate: Mother Lode
Once per long rest, the earth around you cracks and spits shards of raw ore: 8d10 piercing in a 30 foot radius, and you may harvest a grade higher than normal from the crater.
evolves: Harvest a Heaven or Hell grade ore by hand to evolve into a prospector that Towers reward with secret veins.
cost: Greed for ore grows in you; passing an unmined vein requires a DC 15 Wisdom save.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Ignis Bloodline subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire a single candle flickers in a gale; shield it with your body until dawn and carry its flame out unbroken.
secret: The flame only follows you out if you have never set a fire you could not put out.
notice: [Hidden job change. The last ember of Ignis has chosen a hearth. You are it.]
blurb: An Ignis Bloodline sorcerer who carries a sliver of the dead fire spirit's last flame, feeding it and being fed by it.
features: Skill: Ember in the Chest
Your fire spells ignore resistance to fire. Once per turn, when you deal fire damage, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.
Skill: Stoke
As a bonus action, spend hit points (up to your Sorcerer level) to add that much fire damage to your next spell.
Ultimate: Ignis Remembers
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you become a figure of living fire: you shed bright light, deal 2d6 fire to creatures that touch you, and your fire spells deal maximum on one die each.
evolves: At level 15, if the ember has never gone out, it evolves into a flame that can light other people's hearts.
cost: If you are knocked unconscious in water, the ember goes out and the class is sealed until you relight it in a volcano.

requires: Sorcerer level 21, Ignis Bloodline subclass
unlock: On floor 21 of the Ledger Spire, burn every debt plaque on the floor in one night while devils try to put the fires out.
secret: The judgment counts only if one plaque you burn bears your own name.
notice: [Hidden job change. All debts burn the same. Hell's fire is now your witness.]
blurb: An Ignis Bloodline sorcerer who claims hellfire as the dead spirit's cousin, burning away oaths, curses and contracts.
features: Skill: Burned Contract
When you deal fire damage to a creature, you may end one curse, charm or magical bond on it (but you take 2d10 psychic).
Skill: Hellfire Grade
Your fire damage counts as Hell grade: fiends lose fire immunity against you and take only resistance.
Ultimate: Pyre of Ledgers
Once per long rest, a 40 foot radius pillar of black fire burns for 1 minute; creatures inside take 8d10 fire per turn and cannot be bound by contracts while inside.
evolves: Burn a god's written contract to ash and Ignis's old rivals in Heaven will notice you.
cost: You can never again sign a contract with a god without it bursting into flame.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Ignis Bloodline subclass; Alchemy profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, distill a potion that must be heated by your own blood flame alone for twelve hours without a pause.
secret: The potion only works if you drink it yourself before testing it on anyone else.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your blood is a kiln. Every brew is now a blaze.]
blurb: An Ignis Bloodline sorcerer whose body is a perfect alchemical furnace, brewing volatile fire-oils and furnace-tonics.
features: Skill: Blood-Kiln
Alchemy crafting that uses heat takes half the time, and your potions gain +1 Potency.
Skill: Furnace Flask
Throw a flask that bursts into your fire spell of 3rd level or lower without expending a slot, twice per long rest.
Ultimate: Crucible Body
Once per long rest, for 1 minute any potion you drink also affects every ally within 15 feet, and any poison in you is burned away.
evolves: Brew a potion with a Heaven grade fire essence to evolve into an alchemist whose blood itself is a reagent.
cost: You run so hot that you must drink twice as much water as anyone else or gain a level of exhaustion.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Lunar Sorcery subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire the moon shines through a hole in the roof; stand in the beam through all of its phases in one night as the tower turns.
secret: The moon only finishes its phases if you have not cast a spell since sunset.
notice: [Hidden job change. The tide answers you. The moon has a favourite.]
blurb: A Lunar sorcerer who learns to tug the moon's pull like a rope, dragging water, foes and even blood toward or away from her.
features: Skill: Moon Pull
When you hit a creature with a spell, push or pull it up to 10 feet.
Skill: Tide of Phases
Switching your lunar phase now also grants temporary hit points equal to twice your Sorcerer level.
Ultimate: High Tide
Once per long rest, a 30 foot radius rises like a tide around you for 1 minute: enemies in it have half speed and allies can swim through air.
evolves: At level 15, stand in a true eclipse to evolve into a sorcerer who can cast in all three phases at once.
cost: On the new moon, your Charisma drops by 2 for the night.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Lunar Sorcery subclass; Tailoring profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, weave a cloak from strands of moonlight that only appear in mirrors, finishing before your reflection does.
secret: The cloak only holds if it is woven for someone else, not yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. Moonlight has a weave. Your needle can catch it.]
blurb: A Lunar sorcerer who threads moonlight into cloth, sewing phases of the moon into cloaks and armor.
features: Skill: Phase-Stitched
Garments you tailor hold one lunar phase; the wearer gains that phase's minor benefit (light, shadow or healing) once per day.
Skill: Moonlit Lining
Light armor you make grants +1 AC at night and resistance to radiant or necrotic, chosen when made.
Ultimate: Cloak of Three Moons
Once per long rest, every ally wearing your work gains the benefit of all three lunar phases for 1 minute.
evolves: Weave a full outfit from moonlight gathered in the Heaven realm to evolve into a tailor whose cloth holds spells.
cost: Your thread vanishes in direct sunlight; daytime repairs fail.

requires: Sorcerer level 21, Lunar Sorcery subclass; Minor contract with Tsukuyomi or Selene
unlock: On floor 22 of the Choir Spire, stand between the singing sun and the silent moon at the eclipse and accept a vow from the moon god.
secret: The vow only seals if you once refused a sun god's offer of light.
notice: [Hidden job change. You are wed to the shadow of the moon. The eclipse is yours.]
blurb: A Lunar sorcerer bound by contract to a moon god, who carries a pocket eclipse to drown out the sun and other gods' light.
features: Skill: Pocket Eclipse
As an action, create a 20 foot radius of eclipse light for 1 minute; in it, radiant damage is halved and your spells deal an extra 2d8.
Skill: Bridal Veil
While in your eclipse you are invisible to divine magic and scrying.
Ultimate: Night at Noon
Once per long rest, turn day to night in a 1 mile radius for 1 hour; you regain one spell slot of 5th level or lower each 10 minutes.
evolves: Survive a full lunar cycle without seeing sunlight to raise the contract a Finger.
cost: You cannot be healed by radiant magic or by a sun god's priests.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Mirror Mage subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire a mirror copies everything you do; beat it in a spell duel by using only spells it has already cast.
secret: The mirror only yields if you have never shattered a looking glass.
notice: [Hidden job change. You win with their weapons. The glass approves.]
blurb: A Mirror Mage who turns reflection into a duelling art, catching hostile spells mid-flight and throwing them back sharper.
features: Skill: Catch and Return
When a spell of 2nd level or lower targets only you and misses or you save, use your reaction to redirect it at the caster.
Skill: Silvered Edge
Spells you redirect gain +1 to their save DC and extra damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
Ultimate: Hall of Duelists
Once per long rest, for 1 minute three mirrored images of you each cast your cantrips; each image breaks when hit.
evolves: At level 15, return 100 spells to their casters to evolve into a duelist who can catch spells aimed at allies.
cost: Mirrors near you crack when you lose a duel.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Mirror Mage subclass
unlock: Follow your reflection up the Fogglass Spire to floor 12 and swap places with it for an hour without anyone noticing.
secret: The swap only lasts if your reflection is the one who decides to swap back.
notice: [Hidden job change. You and your reflection have traded. Which one is real?]
blurb: A Mirror Mage who lives half on the other side of the glass, sending a reflected self to act where the real one cannot.
features: Skill: Glass Twin
As a bonus action, summon a reflection that shares your hit points and can cast cantrips; it vanishes if you move more than 100 feet away.
Skill: Switch Sides
Once per turn, swap places with your reflection as a free action.
Ultimate: Mirror World
Once per long rest, pull up to 6 creatures into a mirror world for 1 minute; in it, enemies hit themselves on a natural 1 to 5.
evolves: Leave your reflection alone in the mirror world for a year and it may come back as your apprentice.
cost: Sometimes, when you look away, your reflection does not.

requires: Sorcerer level 21, Mirror Mage subclass; Enchanting profession level 6
unlock: On floor 23 of the Ledger Spire, enchant a silver mirror with a devil's reflection inside, then sell the mirror back to the devil at a profit.
secret: The sale only counts if the devil leaves believing it got the better deal.
notice: [Hidden job change. Even a devil's reflection is a commodity. You trade in glass.]
blurb: A Mirror Mage who enchants mirrors to trap images, spells and voices, a dealer in reflected power.
features: Skill: Stored Image
A mirror you enchant can hold one spell cast into it, released later by anyone who breaks it.
Skill: Silver Bargain
When you redirect a spell, you may store it in a carried mirror instead of returning it.
Ultimate: Gallery of Theft
Once per long rest, release every spell in your mirrors at once, each at a different target.
evolves: Trap a god's spell in a mirror to draw the attention of a deity of reflections.
cost: Each mirror you enchant takes a small reflection of you; with ten or more, your shadow fades.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Shadow Magic (Sorcerer) subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, put out every lamp on the floor and eat the last flame without burning your mouth.
secret: The flame only goes down if you have spent at least 3 nights without light before entering.
notice: [Hidden job change. You have swallowed light. Darkness now owes you.]
blurb: A shadow sorcerer who devours light to deepen the dark, snuffing torches and spells.
features: Skill: Snuff
As a bonus action, extinguish nonmagical lights within 30 feet and gain temporary hit points equal to the number put out times 2.
Skill: Eaten Glow
When you take radiant damage, reduce it by your Sorcerer level and add that much necrotic to your next spell.
Ultimate: Hungry Dark
Once per long rest, a 40 foot sphere of magical darkness follows you for 1 minute; enemies inside take 3d8 necrotic each turn.
evolves: At level 15, swallow the light of a Heaven grade lantern to evolve into a shadow that can eat spells.
cost: Sunlight gives you disadvantage on Constitution saves.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Shadow Magic (Sorcerer) subclass
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire a pack of shadow hounds hunts you through the mist; tame their leader by feeding it your own shadow.
secret: The leader only bows if you have never let a summoned creature die for you.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your shadow has puppies. Run, hunters.]
blurb: A shadow sorcerer whose hound grows into a pack, hunting as one from the edges of the dark.
features: Skill: Gloam Pack
Summon two lesser hounds alongside your normal hound; they share half its hit points and bite for 1d8 necrotic.
Skill: Pack Scent
Creatures marked by your hounds cannot hide or turn invisible from you.
Ultimate: The Hunt Does Not End
Once per long rest, all hounds become Large for 1 minute and teleport to any marked creature within a mile.
evolves: Raise a pack of nine hounds to evolve into a sorcerer who rides one.
cost: While your hounds are summoned, you cast no shadow and dogs fear you.

requires: Sorcerer level 41, Shadow Magic (Sorcerer) subclass; Tailoring profession level 7
unlock: Descend to floor 43 of the Sunken Spire and sew a cloak from the shadows of things watching from the stairwells, one stitch per eye.
secret: The cloak only completes if you never look directly at what you are cutting.
notice: [Hidden job change. Even the shadows of the deep can be tailored.]
blurb: A shadow sorcerer who stitches darkness into cloth, wrapping allies in shadows cut from the Abyss itself.
features: Skill: Deep Thread
Shadow-thread garments you make grant darkvision 120 feet and +1 AC in dim light or darkness.
Skill: Stitched Out
As a reaction, stitch an ally's shadow to yours; for 1 minute you share teleportation and damage.
Ultimate: Abyss Cloak
Once per long rest, wrap everything within 60 feet in shadow-cloth for 1 minute; allies are invisible and enemies inside are blinded unless they pass a Wisdom save.
evolves: Weave a garment from Void shadows to evolve into a tailor of absence.
cost: Creatures in the Abyss can always find what you have stitched.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Storm Sorcery subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, deliver a letter from the bottom to the top before the wind blows it out of your hand, without ever touching the stairs.
secret: The letter only counts if you never read it.
notice: [Hidden job change. The wind carries messages for you now.]
blurb: A storm sorcerer whose winds become pure speed, darting across battlefields on gusts.
features: Skill: Gust Step
Your flight from Tempestuous Magic becomes 20 feet, and you can use it on any turn you cast a cantrip.
Skill: Tailwind
Allies who start their turn within 10 feet of you gain +10 feet of speed.
Ultimate: Courier of the Gale
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you have a flying speed of 90 feet and do not provoke opportunity attacks.
evolves: At level 15, deliver 100 messages by wind to evolve into a courier who can carry allies.
cost: You cannot stay still for long; resting without wind makes you restless (no short rest benefits indoors).

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Storm Sorcery subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, temper a blade by catching it in a lightning strike you call down yourself.
secret: The blade only holds the charge if it is forged during an actual thunderstorm outside the tower first.
notice: [Hidden job change. Lightning is your quench. The anvil rings with thunder.]
blurb: A storm sorcerer who forges metal with lightning, imbuing weapons with crackling charge.
features: Skill: Lightning Quench
Weapons you forge deal an extra 1d6 lightning or thunder.
Skill: Conductor
Lightning spells you cast can arc through any metal weapon you forged within 60 feet.
Ultimate: Anvil of Thunder
Once per long rest, strike your anvil to call a lightning storm in a 60 foot radius (10d8 lightning, Dexterity save for half).
evolves: Forge a weapon from Heaven grade storm metal to attract a storm god's interest.
cost: Metal you forge sparks against your skin, dealing 1 lightning damage every time you draw it.

requires: Sorcerer level 21, Storm Sorcery subclass; Minor contract with Thor, Zeus or Susanoo
unlock: On floor 22 of the Choir Spire, out-shout the choir with thunder and stand unmoved when the storm god answers.
secret: The god only accepts you if you have never fled from a storm.
notice: [Hidden job change. A thunder god has heard you. Speak, herald.]
blurb: A storm sorcerer contracted to a thunder god, carrying their bolts and sometimes their temper.
features: Skill: Herald's Voice
Your thunder spells cannot be resisted, and you can speak to anyone within a mile through thunder.
Skill: Borrowed Bolt
Once per turn, add 4d6 lightning to a spell that already deals lightning.
Ultimate: Sky Splits
Once per long rest, call a god's bolt in a 30 foot radius (16d10 lightning, Dexterity save for half).
evolves: Serve the god through a great storm and the contract may rise to a 2nd Finger.
cost: When the god is angry, you are too; Wisdom saves against rage are at disadvantage.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Sylph Bloodline subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire, dance on a floor of thin glass for a full hour without cracking it.
secret: The dance only counts if you weigh less than you did when you entered the tower.
notice: [Hidden job change. You are as light as the air. Dance, and it will dance with you.]
blurb: A Sylph Bloodline sorcerer whose body lightens toward air itself, dodging blows like a leaf in wind.
features: Skill: Leaf Weight
You take no falling damage and can stand on surfaces that would hold a bird.
Skill: Weightless Dodge
Once per round, when hit by a weapon attack, reduce damage by 1d10 plus your Charisma modifier.
Ultimate: Sylph's Last Breath
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you become partly wind: resistance to nonmagical damage and you can pass through spaces 1 inch wide.
evolves: At level 15, dance on a cloud to evolve into a sorcerer who can dance in a storm.
cost: Strong winds push you around; you have disadvantage on checks against being moved.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Sylph Bloodline subclass; Navigation profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, chart a way out of the mist using only the direction the wind blows when you whistle to it.
secret: The wind only answers if you whistle a tune you composed yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. Sylph's ghost whispers directions. You will not be lost again.]
blurb: A Sylph Bloodline sorcerer who reads currents of air as maps, steering ships and parties across realms.
features: Skill: Wind Compass
You always know the way to any place you have been, and Navigation checks gain your Charisma modifier.
Skill: Sailing Breath
Ships or flying mounts you guide gain double speed for 8 hours, once per day.
Ultimate: Road on the Wind
Once per long rest, create a road of wind up to a mile long that carries allies at 120 feet per round.
evolves: Chart a course through the Astral by wind alone to evolve into a navigator of realms.
cost: Without wind, you lose your bearings; underground you have disadvantage on Navigation.

requires: Sorcerer level 31, Sylph Bloodline subclass
unlock: On floor 32 of the Shuffled Spire, breathe in a floor-sized hurricane and hold it until the tower reshuffles.
secret: The hurricane only fits inside you if you have spent a year without lying.
notice: [Hidden job change. The wind lives in your lungs. Exhale carefully.]
blurb: A Sylph Bloodline sorcerer who carries a storm in their lungs, releasing it in bursts of devastating wind.
features: Skill: Lung-Storm
As an action, exhale a 60 foot cone of wind (8d8 bludgeoning, pushes 30 feet, Strength save for half and no push).
Skill: Held Breath
You need not breathe, and gases and inhaled poisons cannot affect you.
Ultimate: The Hurricane Exhales
Once per long rest, release a 120 foot radius hurricane for 1 minute that you move freely; ranged attacks in it fail.
evolves: Breathe in the wind of the Outer Realm to evolve into a sorcerer who carries skies.
cost: While holding the storm you cannot speak spells louder than a whisper; verbal components need a bonus action.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Undine Bloodline subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire a dried well waits; refill it with tears and sorcery until clear water rises.
secret: The water only rises if you have never polluted a stream.
notice: [Hidden job change. The well flows again. Undine's last drop chooses you.]
blurb: An Undine Bloodline sorcerer who becomes a living spring, healing and drowning in equal measure.
features: Skill: Spring Touch
As a bonus action, a creature you touch regains 1d6 plus your Charisma modifier hit points (proficiency bonus times per long rest).
Skill: Undertow
Water spells you cast pull targets 10 feet toward you and reduce speed by 10.
Ultimate: Undine Rises
Once per long rest, for 1 minute a water spirit of Undine fights beside you (hit points equal to 5 times your level, slams 2d8 bludgeoning, heals allies it touches).
evolves: At level 15, refill 10 dry wells to evolve into a sorcerer whose blood is a spring.
cost: Dry heat drains you; in deserts you gain a level of exhaustion each day.

requires: Sorcerer level 41, Undine Bloodline subclass
unlock: Dive through the drowned floors of the Sunken Spire to floor 42 without breathing, carrying only the water you summon.
secret: The dive only counts if you rescue a drowning creature on the way.
notice: [Hidden job change. Pressure is your armor. The deep cannot crush you.]
blurb: An Undine Bloodline sorcerer who weaponizes the crushing pressure of the deep.
features: Skill: Depth Armor
You are immune to Realm Pressure from water and gain +2 AC while underwater.
Skill: Crushing Hand
Spells you cast deal an extra 3d10 bludgeoning as the weight of the sea presses.
Ultimate: Ocean's Floor
Once per long rest, drag a 60 foot radius to the bottom of the Abyss for 1 minute; enemies take 10d10 bludgeoning each round.
evolves: Swim to the Sunken Spire's lowest floor to evolve into a sorcerer of the abyssal deep.
cost: On land, you feel the air is too thin; you have -1 AC out of water.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Undine Bloodline subclass; Cooking profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, cook a soup with water you call from the mist and feed it to a stranger who looks like you.
secret: The stranger only finishes the bowl if you added nothing but water.
notice: [Hidden job change. Water is the first ingredient. You are now its chef.]
blurb: An Undine Bloodline sorcerer who cooks with spirit-water, making broths that heal and soups that drown.
features: Skill: Spirit Broth
Meals you cook restore extra hit points equal to your Sorcerer level and cure one disease.
Skill: Tide Soup
A soup you cook lets eaters breathe water and swim at their walking speed for 8 hours.
Ultimate: Feast of Waters
Once per long rest, a feast you serve fully heals up to six eaters and grants them resistance to cold for a day.
evolves: Cook with Heaven grade spring water to evolve into a cook whose broth can raise the dead.
cost: You cannot drink alcohol without it turning to water.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Voidborn subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, sit in a room of ringing bells until every bell stops ringing, without casting a spell.
secret: The bells only stop if you were born on a night with no moon.
notice: [Hidden job change. The bells fell silent. Silence was always yours.]
blurb: A Voidborn sorcerer who sharpens the native hush into a bubble where enemies' magic dies.
features: Skill: Null Bubble
Your silencing aura spreads to 15 feet and enemies in it have disadvantage on concentration saves.
Skill: Quiet Hands
You may cast spells without verbal components.
Ultimate: The Unspoken
Once per long rest, for 1 minute no spells can be cast within 30 feet of you except your own.
evolves: At level 15, silence a whole battlefield to evolve into a sorcerer who silences spells across a city.
cost: Bards and singers are uneasy near you; you cannot gain inspiration from music.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Voidborn subclass; Enchanting profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, enchant a shard of glass with nothing at all, and sell it to a merchant who believes it holds a spell.
secret: The shard only works if you truly put nothing into it.
notice: [Hidden job change. You enchanted emptiness. It sold.]
blurb: A Voidborn sorcerer who enchants items with absence, making gear that eats magic.
features: Skill: Null Charm
Charms you craft grant the wearer advantage on saves against spells.
Skill: Empty Blade
A weapon you enchant ends one magical effect on a creature it hits, once per turn.
Ultimate: Void Lattice
Once per long rest, your crafted items form a lattice that blocks all spells passing through a 30 foot wall.
evolves: Enchant a Void grade crystal with pure absence and the class evolves into a crafter whose items cannot be dispelled or suppressed.
cost: Your null items cannot tell friend from foe: they also blunt helpful spells cast on their wearers (healing on them is halved).

requires: Sorcerer level 41, Voidborn subclass; has visited the Void realm
unlock: On floor 45 of the Sunken Spire, stare into a crack leading to the Void and do not look away for a full day.
secret: The Void only stares back if you were truly born touched by it.
notice: [Hidden job change. The Void remembers you. Welcome home.]
blurb: A Voidborn sorcerer who leans into Void heritage, partly unmaking themselves to unmake others.
features: Skill: Unmade Edge
Your spells deal force damage that ignores resistance and immunity.
Skill: Gone and Back
As a reaction, vanish into the Void until the end of your next turn.
Ultimate: Void Breach
Once per long rest, tear a 30 foot rift to the Void for 1 minute; creatures that end their turn inside are erased from existence unless they pass a Charisma save (else 20d10 force).
evolves: Survive a week in the Void without light to evolve into something the Void calls kin.
cost: Your memories start to fade; you forget one minor fact each day.

requires: Sorcerer level 5, Wild Magic (Sorcerer) subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, roll a die a hundred times and get the same number twice in a row ten times without magic.
secret: The streak only counts if you bet everything you own on it.
notice: [Hidden job change. The dice have noticed you. Luck leans your way now.]
blurb: A Wild Magic sorcerer who learns to coax the chaos, nudging surges toward useful results.
features: Skill: Weighted Surge
When you roll on the Wild Magic table, roll twice and choose.
Skill: Lucky Break
Once per short rest, turn a natural 1 on any roll into a natural 20.
Ultimate: House Always Wins
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every surge you trigger affects enemies instead of you.
evolves: At level 15, win a bet with a god of chance to evolve into a sorcerer who can bend probability.
cost: Luck balances; your next roll after Lucky Break is always a 1.

requires: Sorcerer level 31, Wild Magic (Sorcerer) subclass; carries a fragment of the Chaos Rune
unlock: On floor 31 of the Shuffled Spire, let your soul get shuffled with the tower's floors and find your way back to yourself.
secret: The shuffle only resolves if you accept whichever version of you comes back.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your soul has been reshuffled. Who are you now?]
blurb: A Wild Magic sorcerer whose soul is woven into the Chaos Rune, changing form and ability with every surge.
features: Skill: Shuffled Form
Each surge changes your creature type and grants a random resistance.
Skill: Chaos Lens
Spells you cast change their damage type to whatever the target is most vulnerable to.
Ultimate: Reshuffle
Once per long rest, reshuffle the battlefield: swap positions of all creatures within 100 feet.
evolves: Hold a full Chaos Rune to follow the progenitor of Chaos as a Legendary.
cost: Every morning, roll to see what your personality is today.

requires: Sorcerer level 11, Wild Magic (Sorcerer) subclass; Alchemy profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, brew a potion where a random ingredient falls in each time the mist shifts, then drink it without testing it first.
secret: The brew only takes if you drink it in front of someone who bet against you.
notice: [Hidden job change. Unpredictable, yes. Undrinkable, no. You bottle surges now.]
blurb: A Wild Magic sorcerer who learns to bottle surges, brewing potions that do something wonderful or something terrible.
features: Skill: Bottled Surge
When you roll on the Wild Magic table, you may bottle the result instead; throw the flask (30 feet) to release it centred on the impact point.
Skill: Steady Mix
Allies who drink your potions roll their effects twice and take the better result.
Ultimate: Chaos Cocktail
Once per long rest, brew and throw a cocktail that triggers three Wild Magic results at once; you pick one of them, the others are random.
evolves: Brew with Chaos grade ingredients from the Shuffled Spire and your flasks may hold whole floors of it.
cost: Your flasks are unstable: whenever you take fire or thunder damage, roll a d20, and on a 1 one flask bursts on you.

requires: Warlock level 5, Diamond's Patron subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, sift a floor of broken glass by hand and find the one sliver that is truly Diamond's.
secret: The sliver only reveals itself if your hands bleed onto it at least once and you do not heal them until you leave.
notice: [Hidden job change. One shard returned. Diamond is a little less broken.]
blurb: A warlock who stops merely drawing on Diamond's shattered remains and starts collecting them, each shard sharpening the pact.
features: Skill: Faceted Skin
While you carry at least one of Diamond's shards you gain +1 AC, and the first creature to hit you each turn is dazzled (disadvantage on its next attack).
Skill: Prism Split
One beam of your Eldritch Blast each turn may split to strike two creatures within 10 feet of each other for half damage each.
Ultimate: The Patron Reassembled
Once per long rest, your shards orbit you for 1 minute; each blocks one attack outright, up to your Charisma modifier.
evolves: At level 15, gather ten shards and they fuse into a setting stone, evolving the class into one Diamond calls its keeper.
cost: Each shard whispers; with more than five you hear Diamond's grief every night and gain no benefit from a long rest on a failed DC 12 Wisdom save.

requires: Warlock level 11, Diamond's Patron subclass; Carving profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, cut a raw gem so cleanly that its reflection burns the mist off the whole floor.
secret: The cut only works if you cut along the stone's flaw rather than around it, as Diamond was broken.
notice: [Hidden job change. You cut where Diamond broke. The light obeys the cutter.]
blurb: A Diamond's Patron warlock who carves gems the way Diamond was carved, every facet a small piece of pact power.
features: Skill: Flaw-Cut Gem
Gems you carve gain +1 Potency and can each hold one warlock spell, released by whoever shatters them.
Skill: Refraction Setting
Gem-set gear you craft grants +1 AC and flashes 1d10 radiant at the first creature that hits the wearer each round.
Ultimate: Broken Light
Once per long rest, shatter a carved gem: every enemy within 30 feet takes 8d8 radiant and is blinded for 1 round (Constitution save for half, not blinded).
evolves: Carve a Heaven grade gem without a single wasted grain and the Choir Spire will commission crowns from you.
cost: Every gem you cut leaves a matching cut on your palm that does not close until the gem is used.

requires: Warlock level 21, Diamond's Patron subclass
unlock: On floor 21 of the Choir Spire, stand trial for Diamond's fall while angels test your body with blades until one breaks against your skin.
secret: The blade only breaks if you have never broken a vow made in Diamond's name.
notice: [Hidden job change. The blade broke. You did not. The court will hear you.]
blurb: A Diamond's Patron warlock who takes on Diamond's unbreakable nature and testifies for the shattered patron in Heaven's courts.
features: Skill: Diamond Body
While above half your hit points, no single hit can reduce you below 1 hit point.
Skill: Testimony
Your spoken words cannot be magically altered, and creatures within 30 feet know when you speak the truth.
Ultimate: Clarity of the Stone
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you are immune to all damage and conditions, but your speed is 0 and you cannot cast spells above 3rd level.
evolves: Win Diamond's case before the Choir and the shattered patron may point you toward its Rune.
cost: You cannot speak a lie, even to save a friend's life.

requires: Warlock level 5, Iron's Patron subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire, guard a rusted door for a day and a night and scrub every fleck of rust from it before dawn.
secret: The door only opens if you never sit down during the vigil and never ask what is behind it.
notice: [Hidden job change. Iron trusts you with his seal. Stand watch.]
blurb: An Iron's Patron warlock who sharpens the sealed god's endurance into iron-hard defense, a living lock on a living door.
features: Skill: Iron Skin
Gain +1 AC and resistance to nonmagical piercing damage while you are not wearing heavy armor.
Skill: Unbending
While you have not moved this turn, you cannot be pushed, pulled or knocked prone, and creatures you hit with a spell have their speed halved.
Ultimate: The Seal Holds
Once per long rest, for 1 minute neither you nor allies within 15 feet can drop below 1 hit point.
evolves: At level 15, hold a gate against a hundred foes alone and the class evolves into Iron's sworn gatekeeper.
cost: Rust follows you: acid deals double damage to you, and you take 1 damage per minute in saltwater.

requires: Warlock level 21, Iron's Patron subclass
unlock: On floor 22 of the Ledger Spire, find the plaque that lists the debt Iron was sealed for and break the chain riveted through it.
secret: The chain only breaks if you refuse every payment the devils offer to leave it alone, and they offer three times.
notice: [Hidden job change. One link broken. Somewhere, Iron flexes a finger.]
blurb: An Iron's Patron warlock working to free the sealed god, link by link, by breaking every chain, seal and binding in the way.
features: Skill: Link-Breaker
Your spells end grappled, restrained and magical binding effects on any targets you choose.
Skill: The Jailer's Mark
Creatures that have restrained or imprisoned anyone in the last day take an extra 3d8 force from your spells.
Ultimate: A Finger Moves
Once per long rest, borrow a breath of Iron's sealed strength: a 60 foot radius burst of 10d10 force, and every lock, chain and seal within it opens.
evolves: Break all seven of Iron's seals and the sealed god will name you his Legendary heir.
cost: Iron's jailers, in Hell and Heaven both, have your description.

requires: Warlock level 11, Iron's Patron subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, forge a key that fits a lock you have never seen, using your own pact weapon as the metal.
secret: The key only fits if the forge is lit with a spell and quenched in water you have prayed over to Iron.
notice: [Hidden job change. Iron's fingers guide your hammer. The forge is a shrine.]
blurb: An Iron's Patron warlock whose smithing is worship, every blade a prayer to the sealed god of metal.
features: Skill: Prayer-Forged
Iron and steel items you forge cannot be broken by nonmagical means and gain +1 Potency.
Skill: Pact Steel
Your pact weapon, if you forged it, gains +1 to attack and damage and deals force instead of its normal type.
Ultimate: Iron Rain
Once per long rest, a hail of iron blades falls in a 30 foot radius for 1 round (10d8 slashing, Dexterity save for half).
evolves: Forge a weapon from a link of Iron's own chain to become his armorer.
cost: Your best piece of each year must be offered to Iron by burying it; keeping it ends your pact powers until you do.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Archfey (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, a fey court holds a dance; win a lord's favour without once telling them your real name.
secret: The favour is only granted if you arrived wearing something borrowed and give it away at the dance.
notice: [Hidden job change. The court has noticed you. Mind your manners.]
blurb: An Archfey warlock who sharpens fey charm into courtly etiquette as sharp as any blade.
features: Skill: Courtly Bow
Creatures charmed by you cannot attack your allies, and charm duration doubles.
Skill: Thorn-Tongue
When a creature breaks a promise made to you, it takes 3d8 psychic and is frightened for 1 round.
Ultimate: The Revel Begins
Once per long rest, every creature within 30 feet must dance for 1 minute (Wisdom save); dancers have half speed and cannot use reactions.
evolves: At level 15, win a debt from a fey lord to evolve into a courtier who can call on the court.
cost: You must honour every promise you make, literally; breaking one deals you 2d10 psychic.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Archfey (Patron) subclass; Harvesting profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, grow a fairy ring of mushrooms in a room with no soil and sit in it for a night.
secret: The ring only grows if you plant one mushroom from the place you were born.
notice: [Hidden job change. The ring is yours. The fey cannot cross it without permission.]
blurb: An Archfey warlock who cultivates fairy rings, growing doors to the patron's realm.
features: Skill: Ringwork
Planting a ring takes 10 minutes; you can step from any ring to another you planted within a mile.
Skill: Harvest of Wonders
Herbs and mushrooms you harvest near rings gain +1 grade, once per day.
Ultimate: Ring of Exile
Once per long rest, trap a creature inside a ring for 1 minute (Charisma save); it is banished to the fey court while trapped.
evolves: Plant a ring in every realm you visit to evolve into a warden of the crossing.
cost: Fey will try to dance in your rings at night; you will have visitors.

requires: Warlock level 31, The Archfey (Patron) subclass; Minor contract with Morrigan
unlock: On floor 33 of the Shuffled Spire, wed the Archfey in a ceremony where you wear a new face each hour.
secret: The marriage only binds if you have not seen your true reflection in a year.
notice: [Hidden job change. The fey have married you. Your face is now theirs.]
blurb: An Archfey warlock contracted to Morrigan, who trades faces as the fey trade promises.
features: Skill: Stolen Face
Take the face and voice of a creature you have touched, flawlessly, once per short rest.
Skill: Crow-Wed
Ravens within a mile tell you what they see.
Ultimate: The Thousand Faces
Once per long rest, every enemy within 60 feet sees you as their own ally for 1 minute (Wisdom save).
evolves: Wear the face of a god once and Morrigan may raise the contract a Finger.
cost: You can no longer remember your own face.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Ashen Eye subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, sit by a fire and read a stranger's past in its smoke before the fire dies.
secret: The smoke only shows the past if you burn something precious to you.
notice: [Hidden job change. The Ashen Eye looks through your eyes.]
blurb: An Ashen Eye warlock who reads truth in smoke and ash, seeing through lies and illusions.
features: Skill: Smoke Sight
You see through smoke, fog and illusions within 30 feet.
Skill: Ash Mark
Mark a creature with ash; you know its location for 1 hour.
Ultimate: The Eye Opens
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you see everything within 300 feet as if standing beside it.
evolves: At level 15, read a god's past in smoke to evolve into a seer of the patron.
cost: Smoke in your eyes never clears; you have disadvantage on Perception in clear light.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Ashen Eye subclass
unlock: On floor 23 of the Ledger Spire, a debt plaque was burned to hide a crime; read the truth from its ash and name the culprit to the devil who keeps the books.
secret: The ash only speaks if you have watched, without intervening, at least one thing you could have stopped.
notice: [Hidden job change. The burnt-out watcher has a witness. Hell takes note.]
blurb: An Ashen Eye warlock who becomes the patron's witness in Hell, reading the ash of burned records to expose every hidden debt.
features: Skill: Ash Ledger
Touch any ash and learn what burned and who lit it.
Skill: Witness Brand
A creature you watch for a full round has disadvantage on Deception and cannot turn invisible to you for 1 hour.
Ultimate: The Burnt Record Speaks
Once per long rest, every enemy within 60 feet relives its worst crime as smoke chokes it: 10d8 psychic and stunned for 1 round (Wisdom save for half, not stunned).
evolves: Read the ash of a burned god's temple to step toward the Eye's forgotten Rune.
cost: Devils call you as a witness in their trials, and refusing a summons costs a year of your life.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Ashen Eye subclass; Navigation profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, draw a map of the shifting floor using only charcoal from your patron's fire, and walk it blindfolded.
secret: The map only stays true if you draw it with your off hand.
notice: [Hidden job change. The Eye sees the road. Your charcoal draws what it sees.]
blurb: An Ashen Eye warlock who draws maps in charcoal from the patron's burnt-out sight, charting places no traveller has seen.
features: Skill: Ash-Drawn Map
Spend 10 minutes to draw a map of everything within a mile, including hidden doors, though it smudges after a day.
Skill: Smoke Trail
Allies following your map cannot become lost and gain +10 feet of speed while travelling.
Ultimate: The Eye's Atlas
Once per long rest, draw a door on any surface leading to a place on one of your maps within 10 miles; it stays open for 1 minute.
evolves: Map a whole realm in ash to evolve into a cartographer the Ashen Eye trusts with its own memories.
cost: Your maps burn if anyone else copies them, and so does a little of your Wisdom (-1 until long rest).

requires: Warlock level 5, The Celestial (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, walk a lantern through a floor of lost children and lead every one of them to a door marked with a star.
secret: The door only opens if no child was made to walk alone, even for a moment.
notice: [Hidden job change. The lantern burns brighter. Heaven has seen your mercy.]
blurb: A Celestial warlock whose healing light becomes a lantern for the lost, guiding and shielding the weak.
features: Skill: Lantern Light
Your Healing Light dice become d8s, and creatures healed by it gain +1 AC until your next turn.
Skill: Guided Steps
Allies within your lantern's 20 foot light cannot be frightened or lost.
Ultimate: The Light Carries Them
Once per long rest, up to six allies within 60 feet teleport to spaces within 10 feet of you and regain 4d8 hit points.
evolves: At level 15, lead a hundred lost souls home and the lantern evolves into a beacon visible from Heaven.
cost: Creatures of darkness see your lantern from miles away and hunt it.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Celestial (Patron) subclass
unlock: Your Celestial patron sends you into the Ledger Spire to floor 21 to reclaim a fallen angel's feather from a devil's vault.
secret: The vault only opens if you pay with a memory of a time you were truly happy.
notice: [Hidden job change. A feather reclaimed. Heaven sends its thanks, and its next errand.]
blurb: A Celestial warlock sent into Hell on Heaven's errands, reclaiming what fallen angels lost.
features: Skill: Feather Ward
You and allies within 10 feet take no damage from Hell's Realm Pressure and have resistance to fire.
Skill: Reclaim
When you hit a fiend with a spell, it loses one magic item benefit or one resistance until the end of your next turn.
Ultimate: Fallen Wings Return
Once per long rest, the reclaimed feathers burst into 30 foot radiant wings; fiends within take 12d8 radiant (Charisma save for half) and you fly at 60 feet for 1 minute.
evolves: Reclaim a whole wing to evolve into Heaven's most trusted agent in Hell.
cost: Devils remember your face and add your name to their ledgers.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Celestial (Patron) subclass; Enchanting profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, weave a halo from mist and enchant it so it holds its shape outside the tower.
secret: The halo only holds if you give it away to someone who has never prayed.
notice: [Hidden job change. You weave halos. Heaven approves of your craft.]
blurb: A Celestial warlock who enchants halos, circlets and charms with borrowed light from the patron.
features: Skill: Woven Halo
A halo you enchant grants its wearer resistance to necrotic and lets them cast light at will.
Skill: Ringed Light
Up to three wearers of your halos regain 1d8 hit points whenever you use Healing Light on anyone.
Ultimate: Choir of Halos
Once per long rest, all your halos within a mile flare: undead and fiends within 10 feet of any wearer take 8d8 radiant.
evolves: Weave a halo from Heaven grade light to evolve into an enchanter the Choir asks for.
cost: Every halo takes a little of your light; with more than five out, you cannot see in dim light.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Fathomless (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, a flooded hall hides a beast; spear it with a harpoon thrown from your patron's tentacle.
secret: The beast only surfaces if you dive without any light.
notice: [Hidden job change. The tentacle has learned to throw. Hunt, harpooner.]
blurb: A Fathomless warlock who turns the patron's tentacle into a harpoon, dragging prey into the deep.
features: Skill: Tentacle Harpoon
Your tentacle's attack pulls the target 15 feet toward you on a hit.
Skill: Deep Grip
Creatures hit by the tentacle have speed 0 until the end of your next turn.
Ultimate: Drag Them Down
Once per long rest, the tentacle grapples up to three creatures and drags them 30 feet underwater or underground; they cannot breathe while held.
evolves: At level 15, harpoon a sea monster to evolve into a hunter of leviathans.
cost: You cannot stay dry; your hair and clothes always drip seawater.

requires: Warlock level 41, The Fathomless (Patron) subclass
unlock: Descend the Sunken Spire to floor 41 and make an offering to your patron at a shrine at the bottom of a drowned stair.
secret: The patron only accepts you if you offered something warm and living, then let it go free.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your patron's tide answers your call.]
blurb: A Fathomless warlock who becomes a priest of the deep tides, calling waves through the dark.
features: Skill: Tide Pressure
Enemies within 30 feet suffer Realm Pressure 3 higher than normal.
Skill: Abyssal Lure
As a bonus action, a soft light from your palm draws creatures 20 feet toward you (Wisdom save).
Ultimate: The Black Tide Rises
Once per long rest, water fills a 100 foot radius for 1 minute; enemies who cannot breathe water start drowning.
evolves: Call the patron's tide to the surface to evolve into its chosen prophet.
cost: Your patron's hunger grows in you; you must eat raw fish daily.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Fathomless (Patron) subclass; Harvesting profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, dive into a pool in the mist and come up with a black pearl the size of a fist.
secret: The pearl only comes up if you leave a white pearl in exchange.
notice: [Hidden job change. The deep trades with you now.]
blurb: A Fathomless warlock who dives for treasures of the deep and trades them for favours and coin.
features: Skill: Pearl Sense
You know the location of every pearl, shell and sea treasure within a mile of water.
Skill: Black Pearl Charm
Pearls you harvest can be traded to sea creatures for one service each.
Ultimate: The Deep Pays
Once per long rest, dive for 1 minute and return with a random treasure of a grade higher than the local realm.
evolves: Trade with a leviathan to evolve into the deep's chosen merchant.
cost: Sea creatures expect payment for every favour; forgetting earns a curse.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Fiend (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, a devil asks you to copy a contract by hand without changing a word; find the hidden clause and fix it.
secret: The job only triggers if you show the devil the error rather than exploiting it yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. The devils are impressed. A scribe is born.]
blurb: A Fiend warlock who learns that power in Hell comes from paperwork, writing small contracts that bind foes.
features: Skill: Fine Print
When a creature agrees to anything you say, it is bound for 1 hour; breaking it costs 2d10 fire.
Skill: Signed in Blood
Your Dark One's Blessing temporary hit points double while you hold a signed contract.
Ultimate: Binding Clause
Once per long rest, a creature you have contracted with cannot attack you for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 15, write a contract a devil cannot break to evolve into a scribe of Hell.
cost: Devils ask you to review their contracts, and refusing is a breach.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Fiend (Patron) subclass
unlock: Climb to floor 23 of the Ledger Spire and defeat a lesser archdevil in a duel of fire, then take its crown.
secret: The crown only fits if you have killed at least one fiend without your patron's help.
notice: [Hidden job change. A crown taken in Hell. Your patron is not pleased.]
blurb: A Fiend warlock who grows ambitious, stealing a piece of Hell's hierarchy and rivalling the patron.
features: Skill: Usurped Flame
Your fire spells ignore immunity and set targets alight (1d10 fire each turn until they act to stop it).
Skill: Lesser Throne
Fiends of CR 10 or lower must pass a Charisma save to attack you.
Ultimate: Coronation of Ash
Once per long rest, for 1 minute you wear a crown of hellfire; any creature that ends its turn within 20 feet takes 6d10 fire.
evolves: Take your patron's own crown to become a Legendary rival.
cost: Your patron and every devil above you want you dead.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Fiend (Patron) subclass; Cooking profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, cook a meal over hellfire for a devil and make it ask for seconds.
secret: The devil only asks for seconds if the dish contains something you gathered yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. Even Hell appreciates a good meal.]
blurb: A Fiend warlock who cooks with hellfire, serving meals that fuel fury and resilience.
features: Skill: Hellfire Kitchen
Meals you cook grant resistance to fire and 1d10 extra temporary hit points.
Skill: Spiced Rage
Eaters of your meals deal an extra 1d6 fire with their first attack each turn for 1 hour.
Ultimate: Banquet of Brimstone
Once per long rest, a feast you cook means the first time each eater would drop to 0 hit points in the next 24 hours, they drop to 1 instead and burst into 3d10 fire around them.
evolves: Cook a dish for an archdevil to evolve into Hell's head chef.
cost: Your cooking is addictive; eaters crave more and may hunt you.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Genie (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire a cracked lamp asks for three wishes from you; grant each one with only what is in your pockets.
secret: The lamp only cracks fully open if none of the three wishes is for yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. Wishes granted, small but true. Your vessel grows deeper.]
blurb: A Genie warlock who sharpens the vessel into a little wishing-house, granting small, clever favours to allies.
features: Skill: Pocket Wish
Once per short rest, an ally who spends 1 minute in your vessel may reroll one failed check in the next hour.
Skill: Bottled Room
Your vessel's interior grows to fit six guests, and resting there counts as a short rest in half the time.
Ultimate: The Third Wish
Once per long rest, cast any spell of 4th level or lower from any class list without expending a slot, phrased as a granted wish.
evolves: At level 15, grant a hundred wishes to evolve into a wishwright whose lamp grants greater spells.
cost: Every wish you grant must be phrased exactly; misspoken ones twist in comical ways.

requires: Warlock level 31, The Genie (Patron) subclass; carries a fragment of the Air, Earth, Fire or Water Rune
unlock: On floor 34 of the Shuffled Spire, rule a tiny kingdom of shuffling elemental courtiers for a full reshuffle without losing a single subject.
secret: The court only accepts you if your patron's element and the Rune fragment's element are opposed.
notice: [Hidden job change. The court of elements bows. A small throne is yours.]
blurb: A Genie warlock who bends the patron's element through a Rune fragment, holding court over clashing elements.
features: Skill: Opposed Court
Your Genie's Wrath may deal your patron's damage type or the Rune's, and switching gives the target vulnerability for 1 round.
Skill: Elemental Retinue
Two minor elementals (one of each element) follow you; each acts on your turn and has hit points equal to your level.
Ultimate: The Emir's Decree
Once per long rest, issue a decree: for 1 minute one element of your choice cannot harm you or your allies within 60 feet.
evolves: Hold a full elemental Rune to seek its progenitor's trail.
cost: Genies see you as a rival and refuse to grant you anything.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Genie (Patron) subclass; Tailoring profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, weave a carpet from thread spun from the mist and fly it out of the tower's window.
secret: The carpet only flies if its pattern tells the story of your patron's first master.
notice: [Hidden job change. The carpet rises. Your genie approves.]
blurb: A Genie warlock who weaves flying carpets, tapestries and silk garments that hold elemental power.
features: Skill: Flying Carpet
Weave a carpet that carries up to four Medium creatures at 60 feet flying speed.
Skill: Elemental Silk
Silk garments you weave grant resistance to your patron's element.
Ultimate: The Woven Storm
Once per long rest, your carpet unravels into a storm of silk (10d8 of your patron's element in a 30 foot radius).
evolves: Weave a carpet from Heaven grade silk to evolve into a weaver kings commission.
cost: Your carpets fall if you are knocked unconscious.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Great Old One (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, sit in a silent room and repeat back every whisper from the walls, perfectly, for an hour.
secret: The whispers only accept you if you never speak your own thoughts aloud during the hour.
notice: [Hidden job change. The stars whisper through you. Your mouth is theirs.]
blurb: A Great Old One warlock who sharpens telepathy into whispered commands that slip under the skin.
features: Skill: Undertongue
Your telepathy reaches 60 feet and you can whisper one word as a bonus action that forces a Wisdom save or the target drops what it holds.
Skill: Echoing Thoughts
When you read a creature's thoughts, you also learn its next intended action.
Ultimate: The Stars Say Kneel
Once per long rest, every creature within 30 feet hears the patron's voice (Wisdom save or prone and stunned for 1 round).
evolves: At level 15, speak a word your patron gave you that no mortal knows to evolve into its herald.
cost: The whispers never fully stop; you have disadvantage on saves against sleep.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Great Old One (Patron) subclass; Navigation profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, chart the stars from a sky that changes every time you look away.
secret: The chart only counts if it shows one star that does not exist yet.
notice: [Hidden job change. You charted the impossible. The stars now point to you.]
blurb: A Great Old One warlock who navigates by alien stars, charting paths through realms no one else can see.
features: Skill: Alien Sky
You can navigate by alien stars anywhere, even underground or in the Void.
Skill: Star Path
Once per day, chart a path that halves travel time for up to 8 creatures.
Ultimate: Falling Star
Once per long rest, call down a fragment of an alien star (12d6 force in a 20 foot radius).
evolves: Chart a path to the Great Old One's home to become its navigator.
cost: You dream of the patron's home, and sometimes you sleepwalk toward it.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Great Old One (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 22 of the Choir Spire, teach the choir one note from your patron's song without them noticing it is alien.
secret: The note only sticks if you sing it at the exact moment the choir breathes.
notice: [Hidden job change. Heaven sings an alien note. No one has noticed yet.]
blurb: A Great Old One warlock who corrupts holy music, weaving the patron's alien song into Heaven's choirs.
features: Skill: Off-Key Hymn
Allies within 30 feet are immune to divine charm and fear while you hum.
Skill: Choir Corruption
Radiant damage cast by enemies within 60 feet is converted to psychic.
Ultimate: The Song Beneath
Once per long rest, for 1 minute every creature within 120 feet hears the patron's song; enemies take 6d10 psychic each turn (Wisdom save for half).
evolves: Teach the whole choir the song to become a Legendary heretic.
cost: If Heaven discovers you, you are banned from the Choir Spire forever.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Hexblade (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, sharpen your blade on a whetstone that whispers the names of every enemy it has killed.
secret: The whetstone only speaks if your blade has never been drawn against an innocent.
notice: [Hidden job change. The blade is keener. The hex is sharper.]
blurb: A Hexblade warlock who perfects the curse, turning each duel into a contest the blade has already decided.
features: Skill: Edge of the Curse
Your Hexblade's Curse lets you crit on a 18 to 20 against the target.
Skill: Parry the Hex
As a reaction, add your Charisma modifier to AC against an attack from your cursed target (max +2).
Ultimate: The Blade Decides
Once per long rest, your next hit against the cursed target is a critical hit and deals an extra 6d8 necrotic.
evolves: At level 15, win a hundred duels with the curse to evolve into a duellist whose blade chooses its own victims.
cost: Your blade grows hungry if not drawn for a week and starts whispering.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Hexblade (Patron) subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, forge a second blade in the mist, using shadow as the metal.
secret: The forge only works if your patron's blade is in the fire beside the new one.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your patron has a sibling now.]
blurb: A Hexblade warlock who forges shadow-steel, creating lesser sentient blades as servants of the patron.
features: Skill: Shadowsteel
Weapons you forge from shadow deal necrotic and can be summoned to your hand.
Skill: Sibling Blade
A second shadow blade fights beside you, attacking once per turn (1d8 plus Charisma necrotic).
Ultimate: Arsenal of Night
Once per long rest, summon six shadow blades that strike once each at different targets.
evolves: Forge a blade from Void steel to evolve into a smith of sentient weapons.
cost: Your forged blades whisper to each other and sometimes plot.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Hexblade (Patron) subclass; Minor contract with Morrigan
unlock: On floor 21 of the Ledger Spire, execute a debtor the devils condemned, with one blow, while Morrigan's crow watches.
secret: The execution only counts if the debtor was guilty and you know it.
notice: [Hidden job change. The crow has seen your swing. Fate has a blade.]
blurb: A Hexblade warlock contracted to Morrigan, whose curse marks the fated dead and whose blade fulfils fate.
features: Skill: Fated Mark
Your cursed target cannot benefit from death ward or similar effects.
Skill: Crow-Feathered
When the cursed target dies, you gain 3d10 temporary hit points and Morrigan's crow tells you the next fated foe.
Ultimate: Fate's Edge
Once per long rest, your cursed target at 50 hit points or fewer must pass a Constitution save or die.
evolves: Execute a god's fated foe to raise the contract a Finger.
cost: Morrigan may mark your friends for death, and you must carry it out.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Hollow King subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, sit on an empty throne and give orders to an empty hall for an hour until it echoes back obedience.
secret: The echo only answers if you give every order politely.
notice: [Hidden job change. The empty throne speaks. Your voice carries a crown.]
blurb: A Hollow King warlock who sharpens borrowed authority into commands that echo through the minds of others.
features: Skill: Empty Command
Once per short rest, give a one-word command (as the command spell) without expending a slot.
Skill: Court of Echoes
Creatures within 30 feet must pass a Wisdom save to disobey your spoken requests.
Ultimate: Crowned in Nothing
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your commands affect up to six creatures at once.
evolves: At level 15, rule a real town for a year to evolve into a king whose crown is no longer borrowed.
cost: Nobles sense your authority is false and treat you with contempt.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Hollow King subclass
unlock: On floor 22 of the Ledger Spire, sit on a demon prince's empty throne and refuse to leave until its owner returns.
secret: The throne only accepts you if you are sitting there when the prince returns, unafraid.
notice: [Hidden job change. You sat where a prince sits. Hell does not forget.]
blurb: A Hollow King warlock who takes empty thrones in Hell, ruling places no one else dares to claim.
features: Skill: Throne-Taker
While sitting on any throne, you gain +2 AC and resistance to all damage.
Skill: Unclaimed Domain
Fiends in an area you claim must obey you unless they pass a Charisma save.
Ultimate: The Empty Court
Once per long rest, summon the Hollow King's court of empty armor (six guards with your hit points each).
evolves: Take the throne of an archdevil to become a Legendary pretender.
cost: The rightful owners of every throne you take will return.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Hollow King subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, forge a crown for a king who does not exist and place it on an empty pillow.
secret: The crown only holds power if no jewel is set in it.
notice: [Hidden job change. You make crowns now.]
blurb: A Hollow King warlock who forges hollow crowns that grant borrowed authority to whoever wears them.
features: Skill: Hollow Crown
A crown you forge gives its wearer advantage on Persuasion and Intimidation.
Skill: King's Circlet
Allies wearing your crowns cannot be charmed.
Ultimate: Coronation
Once per long rest, crown an ally: for 1 minute their attacks deal extra force damage equal to your warlock level.
evolves: Forge a crown for a real god to evolve into a smith of authority.
cost: Every crown you forge is hollow; wearing one makes you feel empty.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Star Eater subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, sit beside a dying candle-beast and eat its last light the moment before it goes out, not a breath sooner.
secret: The light only goes down if you have fasted for a full day before entering.
notice: [Hidden job change. The last light was delicious. Your patron purrs.]
blurb: A Star Eater warlock who refines the patron's hunger, feasting on the final sparks of the dying for strength.
features: Skill: Final Bite
When a creature you damaged in the last minute dies within 30 feet, regain hit points equal to your warlock level.
Skill: Dimming Touch
Creatures below half hit points that you hit cannot regain hit points until your next turn.
Ultimate: Swallow the Spark
Once per long rest, a creature at 20 hit points or fewer within 60 feet must pass a Constitution save or its light is eaten and it drops to 0.
evolves: At level 15, eat the last light of a giant or dragon to evolve into a glutton the patron calls its favourite mouth.
cost: Your hunger never fully ends; you must eat twice as much as others or gain exhaustion.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Star Eater subclass
unlock: On floor 23 of the Choir Spire, swallow a single note of the choir's light so the song goes dark for a heartbeat.
secret: The swallowing only works if you are invited to sing first.
notice: [Hidden job change. Heaven's light has a hole in it. You put it there.]
blurb: A Star Eater warlock who bites holes in Heaven's light, a herald of the patron's appetite for holy radiance.
features: Skill: Light-Eater
When you or an ally within 30 feet would take radiant damage, you may eat it, gaining that much temporary hit points instead.
Skill: Darkened Halo
Celestials within 30 feet lose radiant resistance and immunity.
Ultimate: Bite the Sun
Once per long rest, swallow all light in a 120 foot radius for 1 minute; enemies in it are blinded and take 6d10 necrotic each turn.
evolves: Eat the light of an angel to step toward the patron's Rune.
cost: Heaven names you a heretic, and sunlight burns you for 1d6 radiant each hour.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Star Eater subclass; Alchemy profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, distill a potion from a falling star's dust caught before it hits the floor.
secret: The dust only stays bright if you catch it bare-handed.
notice: [Hidden job change. Starlight in a bottle. Your patron hungers for your brews.]
blurb: A Star Eater warlock who distils starlight and the dying glow of beasts into potions that feed or starve.
features: Skill: Bottled Starlight
Potions you brew with starlight heal an extra 2d8 or deal 2d8 radiant when thrown.
Skill: Glow Drain
A thrown potion drains light from a 20 foot area, giving enemies inside disadvantage on attacks.
Ultimate: Starfall Brew
Once per long rest, throw a brew that calls down a falling star (10d10 fire and radiant in a 30 foot radius).
