evolves: Brew from a fallen star of the Heaven realm to evolve into the patron's cupbearer.
cost: Starlight potions dim within a day; you must brew them fresh each dawn.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Undead (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, tend a graveyard for one night so not a single grave is disturbed.
secret: The graveyard only accepts you if you bury a stranger with your own hands.
notice: [Hidden job change. The dead sleep sound. Your patron thanks you.]
blurb: An Undead patron warlock who sharpens the deathly form into a guardian of graves and the restless.
features: Skill: Grave Form
While in your Form of Dread, you gain +1 AC and resistance to necrotic.
Skill: Calm the Dead
Undead within 30 feet must pass a Wisdom save to attack you.
Ultimate: The Dead Stand Guard
Once per long rest, raise six skeletal guardians (hit points equal to your level) for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 15, lay a thousand restless dead to rest to evolve into a keeper of the graves.
cost: The living find you cold and unsettling; Persuasion against them has disadvantage.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Undead (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 21 of the Ledger Spire, hold a wake for a devil that died in debt, keeping its candles lit for three days while its creditors try to blow them out.
secret: The wake only counts if you mourn the devil honestly, finding one kind thing to say over its body.
notice: [Hidden job change. Even a devil had a wake. Your patron's dead rise a little prouder.]
blurb: An Undead patron warlock who keeps the wakes of the damned, burning grave-candles that steady the dead and haunt the living.
features: Skill: Grave-Candle
Light a candle (bonus action); within 30 feet, your Form of Dread frightens on a failed save even creatures immune to fear.
Skill: Long Hall
Undead allies within the candle's light gain your Charisma modifier to AC (max +2) and regain 1d10 hit points each turn.
Ultimate: The Wake Ends
Once per long rest, snuff the candle: every enemy within 60 feet takes 12d8 necrotic and cannot regain hit points for 1 minute (Constitution save for half, and heals normally).
evolves: Hold a wake for a god's corpse and your patron will show you its own grave.
cost: Candles near you burn black, and creditors of the dead now consider you an heir to their debts.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Undead (Patron) subclass; Carving profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, carve a set of bones into a figure that stands and bows to you.
secret: The figure only bows if you used your own fallen teeth among the bones.
notice: [Hidden job change. The bones bow. You carve servants now.]
blurb: An Undead patron warlock who carves bone into servants, charms and armor.
features: Skill: Bone Charm
Carved bone charms grant resistance to necrotic.
Skill: Carved Servant
A bone servant fights beside you, with hit points equal to your level and a 1d10 slam.
Ultimate: Ossuary Armor
Once per long rest, carved bones cover you and allies within 10 feet for 1 minute (+2 AC).
evolves: Carve a dragon's bones to evolve into a carver of undead giants.
cost: Bones you carve remember their former owners and sometimes speak.

requires: Warlock level 5, The Undying (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, fall from the top of a staircase into a pit of spikes and walk away without a scratch.
secret: The fall only spares you if you jump without hesitating.
notice: [Hidden job change. You have cheated death once. Your patron is pleased.]
blurb: An Undying warlock who sharpens the patron's trick of cheating death into a habit of narrow escapes.
features: Skill: Narrow Escape
Once per short rest, when you would drop to 0, drop to 1 instead.
Skill: Unkillable
Death saves succeed on a 9 or higher.
Ultimate: Death Missed
Once per long rest, when you die, return to life at half hit points in the nearest safe place within 1 mile.
evolves: At level 15, cheat death a hundred times to evolve into a warlock death itself avoids.
cost: Death is keeping score; each cheat adds a strand of grey hair.

requires: Warlock level 11, The Undying (Patron) subclass; Alchemy profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, keep a dying stranger alive for a full day with potions alone.
secret: The stranger only lives if you never tell them how close they came to death.
notice: [Hidden job change. The hourglass turns back. You heal like your patron.]
blurb: An Undying warlock who brews the patron's trick of cheating death into potions and medicines.
features: Skill: Undying Draught
Potions you brew can stabilize a dying creature at range by being thrown.
Skill: Turned Glass
A creature who drinks your potion regains hit points equal to the damage it took last round.
Ultimate: Life Reversed
Once per long rest, a creature who died in the last minute returns with 1 hit point when it drinks your elixir.
evolves: Brew a potion from a phoenix feather to evolve into a physician of death's door.
cost: Death notices; once a year it claims a patient you saved.

requires: Warlock level 21, The Undying (Patron) subclass
unlock: On floor 22 of the Choir Spire, the choir sings the names of everyone fated to die this year; find your name in the song and convince a singer to skip it.
secret: The singer only skips your name if you offer to sing another's name aloud in its place, and then refuse to.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your name is missing from Heaven's list. Death does not know where to look.]
blurb: An Undying warlock who scrubs their own name from Heaven's roll of the fated, becoming very hard for death to find.
features: Skill: Unlisted
Spells and effects that would kill you outright instead deal 10d10 necrotic, and divination cannot locate you.
Skill: Borrowed Breath
When an ally within 30 feet fails a death save, you may give them one of your successes instead (they gain one, you lose nothing).
Ultimate: The Song Skips
Once per long rest, choose up to four allies; for 1 minute, when one drops to 0 hit points, they instead regain hit points equal to your warlock level.
evolves: Remove a second name from the list and the patron may teach you how it first cheated death.
cost: Heaven has noticed the gap in its song; angels audit you once a year and every lie found costs 1 maximum hit point.

requires: Warlock level 5, Void Caller subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, shout your patron's name into a chamber that echoes forever, and keep calling until the nothing between planes swallows the echo.
secret: The echo only dies if you called in a whisper the whole time, never once raising your voice.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your call reached the gap between planes. Nothing answered. Nothing is listening.]
blurb: A Void Caller warlock who learns to call the absolute nothing into small spaces, drowning sound, light and footing in emptiness.
features: Skill: Pocket of Nothing
As a bonus action, empty a 5 foot cube within 60 feet for 1 round: no sound, light or air passes, and a creature inside cannot cast spells with verbal components.
Skill: Gap Underfoot
Creatures you hit with Eldritch Blast fall 10 feet into a momentary gap and land prone (Dexterity save).
Ultimate: The Call Goes Through
Once per long rest, open a 20 foot sphere of absolute void for 1 minute; creatures inside take 4d10 force each turn and cannot see, hear or breathe.
evolves: At level 15, open a pocket of nothing large enough to swallow a house and the class evolves into a caller the Void answers by name.
cost: Each pocket you open steals a sound from you: you lose the ability to hear one note of music forever.

requires: Warlock level 41, Void Caller subclass; carries a fragment of any unclaimed Rune
unlock: On floor 45 of the Sunken Spire, carry an unclaimed Rune fragment into the darkest stairwell and let your patron eat half of it.
secret: The patron only bites if you have already turned down a god who offered to claim that fragment.
notice: [Hidden job change. Half a Rune is gone. The other half belongs to you and to nothing.]
blurb: A Void Caller warlock who feeds Rune fragments to the void between planes, wielding the half-erased law that remains.
features: Skill: Half-Law
Choose a Rune fragment you carry; once per turn, you may suppress that Rune's effects or the powers of its holder within 60 feet until your next turn.
Skill: Unwritten Step
As a bonus action, teleport 60 feet through the gap between planes; you leave no trail and cannot be followed by magic.
Ultimate: Erasure
Once per long rest, a 30 foot sphere is unwritten: 20d10 force to everything inside (Constitution save for half), and spells and magic items there are suppressed for 1 minute.
evolves: Feed a whole Rune to the void and the patron may let you see where the gap between planes began.
cost: Every god who holds a Rune can feel you coming, and few of them like it.

requires: Warlock level 11, Void Caller subclass; Tailoring profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, stitch a pocket into your coat that leads into the void between planes, and drop a lit candle into it without it going out.
secret: The pocket only holds if you sew it blindfolded, by feel alone.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your pocket has no bottom. Your needle has no fear.]
blurb: A Void Caller warlock who sews slivers of the gap between planes into cloth, making garments that hide, hold and refuse.
features: Skill: Bottomless Seam
Garments you tailor can hold a pocket with the capacity of a bag of holding; the wearer can pull out any item inside as a free action.
Skill: Unseen Lining
A cloak you sew makes its wearer impossible to scry and gives them +1 AC against spell attacks.
Ultimate: Swallowing Cloak
Once per long rest, a wearer of your work may swallow one spell or projectile aimed at them and release it on their next turn.
evolves: Sew with thread pulled from the Hollow Spire to evolve into a tailor whose seams hold whole rooms.
cost: Your seams sometimes swallow small things forever, and once a month something in your pack is simply gone.

requires: Wizard level 5, Astromancer subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire the ceiling is a night sky with one star missing; find where it fell, carry it back up and pin it into place.
secret: The star only stays pinned if you have named a constellation of your own and told no one its name.
notice: [Hidden job change. The sky is complete again. One constellation answers to you.]
blurb: An Astromancer who stops borrowing starlight in general and binds one private constellation, drawing its shape into every spell.
features: Skill: Private Constellation
Mark up to five points within 60 feet as stars; once per turn, a spell you cast can originate from any star.
Skill: Connect the Stars
When two marked stars are within 30 feet of each other, creatures on the line between them take 2d8 radiant at the start of their turns.
Ultimate: The Shape in the Sky
Once per long rest, your constellation blazes: every creature inside its outline takes 8d10 radiant (Dexterity save for half) and allies inside gain +1 AC for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 15, draw your constellation over a whole battlefield and it evolves into a sky that follows you indoors.
cost: On cloudy nights you cannot prepare new spells.

requires: Wizard level 11, Astromancer subclass; Navigation profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, chart a route to the 20th floor using the stars reflected in the tower's mirrors, then walk it.
secret: The route only holds if you chart it in a single sitting without consulting any book.
notice: [Hidden job change. The stars point the way. You hold the chart.]
blurb: An Astromancer who treats the sky as a map, guiding parties across the Astral and between realms by starlight.
features: Skill: Star Bearings
You always know your location relative to the realm tier you are in, and Navigation checks gain your Intelligence modifier.
Skill: Astral Shortcut
Once per day, chart a route that halves travel time across the Astral for up to 8 creatures.
Ultimate: Falling Road
Once per long rest, starlight builds a bridge up to 1 mile long; travellers on it move at triple speed for 1 hour.
evolves: Chart a route to the Outer Realm by stars alone to become a navigator realms remember.
cost: Your charts only work for those who have looked at the stars with you.

requires: Wizard level 31, Astromancer subclass; carries a fragment of the Cosmic Rune
unlock: On floor 33 of the Shuffled Spire, the floor becomes open space; sing to the stars until three of them change position to answer you.
secret: The stars only move if the Cosmic fragment is held in your mouth while you sing.
notice: [Hidden job change. The stars moved. The Cosmic Rune approves of your voice.]
blurb: An Astromancer who bends starlight through the Cosmic Rune fragment, rearranging small corners of the sky.
features: Skill: Star-Shift
As a bonus action, move a creature hit by your spell 20 feet in any direction, including upward.
Skill: Gravity of Stars
Spells you cast pull creatures within 10 feet of the target 10 feet toward it.
Ultimate: Reordered Heaven
Once per long rest, reorder a 120 foot radius: swap positions of any creatures within it, and enemies take 12d10 force (Constitution save for half).
evolves: Hold the whole Cosmic Rune to begin the path of its progenitor.
cost: Stars watch you; any creature with darkvision can see a faint ring of starlight around you at night.

requires: Wizard level 5, Bladesinging subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, sing a song while duelling a mirror-swordsman, and do not miss a single note or parry.
secret: The mirror only yields if the song you sing is one you wrote yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your song has a blade. Your blade has a song.]
blurb: A Bladesinger who sharpens the song into a single unbroken melody, each verse a sharper cut.
features: Skill: Verse and Cut
Each consecutive turn you hit with a melee attack while singing adds +1 to damage (max +5).
Skill: Unbroken Melody
While your Bladesong is active, you cannot be silenced, and concentration saves gain +2.
Ultimate: Finale
Once per long rest, end your Bladesong to strike every enemy within 10 feet with your weapon, adding your Intelligence modifier times 2 to each hit.
evolves: At level 15, finish a duel without a single wound to evolve into a singer whose blade can harmonise with another.
cost: Mid-song, you cannot stop singing without taking 1d10 psychic.

requires: Wizard level 11, Bladesinging subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, forge a blade that sings when struck, and forge it to the rhythm of your Bladesong.
secret: The blade only sings if you forge it without breathing for the last strike.
notice: [Hidden job change. You forged a blade that sings. Your forge hums with song.]
blurb: A Bladesinger who forges singing blades, each one a weapon and a focus at once.
features: Skill: Singing Steel
Blades you forge can be used as arcane foci and add +1 to spell attack rolls.
Skill: Choir Blade
While wielding your forged blade during Bladesong, enemies have disadvantage on concentration saves within 10 feet.
Ultimate: The Forge Sings
Once per long rest, strike your forged blade to unleash a shockwave (8d10 thunder in a 20 foot radius).
evolves: Forge a blade from Heaven grade silver to evolve into a smith of legendary singing weapons.
cost: Every blade you forge carries a piece of your voice; with too many, you start to lose your speaking voice.

requires: Wizard level 21, Bladesinging subclass; Minor contract with Saraswati
unlock: On floor 22 of the Choir Spire, dance with a blade in time to the choir until a goddess of learning and music joins the dance.
secret: The goddess only joins if you have never used Bladesong to kill an unarmed foe.
notice: [Hidden job change. A goddess dances with you. Your song is holy now.]
blurb: A Bladesinger contracted to a goddess of learning and music, whose sword-dance becomes a holy rite.
features: Skill: Holy Measure
Your melee attacks deal an extra 2d8 radiant while Bladesong is active.
Skill: Partnered Step
An ally within 10 feet may share your Bladesong benefits.
Ultimate: Dance of Creation
Once per long rest, for 1 minute your dance reshapes the battlefield; you may cast one spell of 5th level or lower each turn as a bonus action.
evolves: Dance before a god's throne to raise the contract a Finger.
cost: The goddess may call you to dance at any time, even in battle.

requires: Wizard level 5, Chronomancer subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, repair a broken clock that resets every time you make a mistake, and finish it without a reset.
secret: The clock only ticks again if you leave one gear in it slightly loose on purpose.
notice: [Hidden job change. The clock ticks. You may borrow one more moment.]
blurb: A Chronomancer who sharpens the borrowed reaction into a habit of redoing the moment just past.
features: Skill: Rewind a Breath
Once per short rest, after a creature within 30 feet rolls, rewind it so it rerolls and must use the new result.
Skill: Saved Moment
When you recast a spent spell, it gains +1 to its save DC.
Ultimate: The Last Ten Seconds
Once per long rest, rewind the last round: every creature returns to where it was, and hit points return to what they were.
evolves: At level 15, rewind a hundred moments to evolve into a chronomancer who rewinds whole fights.
cost: Each rewind costs a few seconds of your own memory.

requires: Wizard level 11, Chronomancer subclass; Alchemy profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, brew a potion that must be finished the moment before it begins boiling.
secret: The potion only works if you brewed it with sand from a broken hourglass.
notice: [Hidden job change. Time is an ingredient. You are its alchemist.]
blurb: A Chronomancer who brews time into potions, slowing, speeding and preserving.
features: Skill: Slow Brew
Potions you brew never spoil and take effect at the moment of your choosing within an hour.
Skill: Quick Draught
A drinker gains an extra action on its next turn.
Ultimate: Pause Potion
Once per long rest, a thrown potion freezes everything in a 20 foot radius for 1 round.
evolves: Brew with sand gathered from the First Spire to evolve into an alchemist whose potions can age or un-age a creature.
cost: Every potion you brew ages you by one day, and the years add up faster than you think.

requires: Wizard level 21, Chronomancer subclass
unlock: On floor 22 of the Ledger Spire, borrow an hour from a devil, use it, and repay it before the devil notices it is missing.
secret: The debt only clears if you pay back more time than you took.
notice: [Hidden job change. You owe Hell an hour. Hell owes you an hour. The ledger balances.]
blurb: A Chronomancer who trades time with devils, borrowing turns and repaying in years.
features: Skill: Loaned Turn
Once per long rest, take an extra full turn; you then age a month.
Skill: Interest Owed
A creature who harms you loses its reaction until the end of its next turn.
Ultimate: The Hour Is Due
Once per long rest, every enemy within 60 feet loses its next turn (Wisdom save).
evolves: Pay off your whole debt to evolve into a wizard Hell respects.
cost: Hell keeps a ledger of your borrowed time, and collects it at your death.

requires: Wizard level 5, Chronurgy Magic subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire a great pendulum swings through a corridor of blades; stop it at the top of its arc with a spell and hold it there while the party passes.
secret: The pendulum only obeys if you count its swings aloud and never once lose count.
notice: [Hidden job change. The pendulum stopped at your word. Time has a hinge, and you found it.]
blurb: A Chronurgy wizard who studies time as a swinging weight, stalling creatures at the top of their arc before letting them fall.
features: Skill: Top of the Arc
When you use your Chronal Shift, the creature also cannot move until the start of its next turn.
Skill: Return Swing
A creature you froze with Arcane Abeyance or a hold spell takes 3d8 force when the effect ends.
Ultimate: Grand Pendulum
Once per long rest, choose up to four creatures within 60 feet: each one either loses its next turn or takes two turns in a row next round (your choice for each).
evolves: At level 15, hold a pendulum still for a full day and it evolves into a savant who can stall a whole army.
cost: Your heartbeat follows the pendulum; you hear it ticking in silence and have disadvantage on saves against sleep.

requires: Wizard level 11, Chronurgy Magic subclass; Engineering profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, build a clock from salvaged parts that runs backwards, set it to the hour you entered, and walk out before it catches up.
secret: The clock only runs if one gear in it is taken from a timepiece you once owned.
notice: [Hidden job change. Gears and moments mesh. You build machines that tick in two directions.]
blurb: A Chronurgy wizard who builds clockwork that regulates time the way an escapement regulates a watch, metering out seconds to friends and foes.
features: Skill: Pocket Escapement
A clockwork device you carry lets the party add your Intelligence modifier to initiative.
Skill: Ticking Trap
Set a clockwork trap in 1 minute; when triggered, creatures in a 10 foot cube are slowed (as the spell) for 1 minute (Wisdom save ends).
Ultimate: The Great Escapement
Once per long rest, wind a tower clock that grants allies within 60 feet an extra action each turn for 3 rounds.
evolves: Build a clock that runs on a fragment of the Time Rune to evolve into an engineer of ages.
cost: Every device you build ticks loud enough to ruin stealth for the party.

requires: Wizard level 21, Chronurgy Magic subclass; Minor contract with Varuna
unlock: On floor 22 of the Choir Spire, hear a case argued by a soul's past and future selves, and pass a sentence both will accept.
secret: The sentence only stands if you rule without being told which self is which.
notice: [Hidden job change. Past and future accept your verdict. Cosmic order takes note.]
blurb: A Chronurgy wizard contracted to a god of cosmic order, who sentences creatures to spend time as the law sees fit.
features: Skill: Time Served
A creature you hit with a spell is sentenced: it ages, rests or waits 1 round outside of time and reappears at the end of its next turn (Charisma save).
Skill: Order Restored
As a reaction, undo one teleport, haste or time effect cast by an enemy within 60 feet.
Ultimate: The Cosmic Docket
Once per long rest, every enemy within 120 feet must pass a Charisma save or be removed from time for 1 minute, returning one at a time in the order you choose.
evolves: Hold the contract for a century of Heaven's time and Varuna may raise it to a 2nd Finger.
cost: Order binds you too: you must always act on your initiative count and may never ready or delay.

requires: Wizard level 5, Graviturgy Magic subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire, an old mill's stone has stopped turning; turn it for a whole day using nothing but shifts of its weight.
secret: The millstone only turns if you grind the village's grain for free with it afterward.
notice: [Hidden job change. The stone turns at your word. Weight is a tool.]
blurb: A Graviturgy wizard who sharpens weight into a grinding, crushing pressure that wears foes down turn after turn.
features: Skill: Grinding Weight
A creature you make heavier with Adjust Density also takes 1d8 bludgeoning at the start of each of its turns.
Skill: Millwheel Orbit
Loose stones orbit you; you gain +1 AC and can fling one as a bonus action (2d6 bludgeoning, 60 feet).
Ultimate: The Stone Comes Down
Once per long rest, drop a 20 foot millstone of force on a point within 120 feet (10d10 bludgeoning, Dexterity save for half; on a fail, restrained under it).
evolves: At level 15, crush a fortress gate with weight alone and the class evolves into a scholar who can make a mountain kneel.
cost: You feel every ounce: carrying capacity is halved for you.

requires: Wizard level 41, Graviturgy Magic subclass; carries a fragment of the Gravity Rune
unlock: On floor 44 of the Sunken Spire, where up and down are uncertain, plant the Gravity fragment in the stairwell and make the whole floor fall toward you.
secret: The floor only falls if you planted the fragment with your bare hands while upside down.
notice: [Hidden job change. The Sunken Spire falls toward you. You are the anchor now.]
blurb: A Graviturgy wizard who binds a Gravity Rune fragment to their own body, becoming the point the world falls toward.
features: Skill: Personal Downward
You choose your own gravity: walk on walls and ceilings and ignore Realm Pressure effects that push or pull.
Skill: Fall Toward Me
As a bonus action, creatures you choose within 60 feet are pulled 30 feet toward you (Strength save).
Ultimate: Singular Point
Once per long rest, become a well of gravity for 1 minute: enemies within 60 feet take 10d10 force at the start of each turn and cannot move away from you.
evolves: Hold the whole Gravity Rune to walk toward its progenitor.
cost: Small objects drift toward you constantly; you can never hide in a room with loose dust.

requires: Wizard level 11, Graviturgy Magic subclass; Engineering profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, build a lift that rises with no rope by balancing it against a counterweight you make heavier with a spell.
secret: The lift only rises if you ride it yourself on its first trip.
notice: [Hidden job change. Counterweights answer you. Buildings will float.]
blurb: A Graviturgy wizard who builds structures and siege engines balanced by spells of weight.
features: Skill: Weighted Engine
Siege engines you build deal extra damage equal to your Intelligence modifier times 2.
Skill: Floating Bridge
Spend 10 minutes to raise a bridge or platform of up to 60 feet that floats until dismissed.
Ultimate: Trebuchet of the Sky
Once per long rest, launch a boulder made ten times heavier (12d10 bludgeoning in a 30 foot radius).
evolves: Raise a whole keep off the ground and keep it floating for a month to evolve into an engineer of floating towns.
cost: Everything you have floated drops the moment you die or fall unconscious for more than a minute.

requires: Wizard level 5, Order of Scribes subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, write one perfect character with a brush while the floor shakes, and have your awakened book judge it.
secret: The book only accepts the character if it is the first letter of your book's own name, which you must guess.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your book has a name now. Your ink is alive.]
blurb: An Order of Scribes wizard who sharpens the awakened spellbook's ink into living calligraphy that crawls off the page.
features: Skill: Crawling Ink
Your book's ink can crawl to a surface within 30 feet and form a glyph that casts a 1st level spell when triggered.
Skill: Inked Reply
When you cast a spell, your book may cast a cantrip as a bonus action.
Ultimate: The Page Turns
Once per long rest, every ink glyph you have placed fires at once.
evolves: At level 15, write a book of your own spells to evolve into a calligrapher whose book can write itself.
cost: Your book grows opinions and sometimes refuses to open.

requires: Wizard level 21, Order of Scribes subclass; carries a fragment of the Word Rune
unlock: On floor 21 of the Choir Spire, copy the choir's song into your awakened book letter by letter, then let the Word fragment read it back.
secret: The Word fragment only reads if your book agrees, and it only agrees if you have never torn a page from it.
notice: [Hidden job change. Heaven's song is in your book. The Word Rune has learned to read.]
blurb: An Order of Scribes wizard whose awakened book drinks from the Word Rune, turning written words into law.
features: Skill: Written Law
Write a word on a creature (touch); while it bears it, the word is true for it for 1 minute (Stop, Kneel, Silence, or Burn for 4d10 fire), Charisma save.
Skill: Annotated Spell
Spells cast from your book may change their damage type to the type named in the margin.
Ultimate: The Last Page
Once per long rest, your book writes a final page: one spell of 8th level or lower that you have seen cast is copied and cast immediately.
evolves: Fill your book with every Word you have ever spoken to step toward the Word Rune's progenitor.
cost: Your book records your every word; anyone who reads it learns your secrets.

requires: Wizard level 11, Order of Scribes subclass; Tailoring profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, bind a new cover for your awakened book from hide you tanned and stitched yourself, and let it choose the colour.
secret: The book only accepts its new skin if the hide came from a creature that once tried to destroy it.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your book has a new cover. It approves of your stitching.]
blurb: An Order of Scribes wizard who binds books in enchanted vellum, making spellbooks that protect their owners.
features: Skill: Bound Ward
Books you bind grant their holder +1 AC and resistance to fire.
Skill: Stitched Spells
A book you bind for an ally holds one of your spells, which they may cast once per day.
Ultimate: Library of Hides
Once per long rest, summon every book you have bound to orbit you, absorbing one spell each.
evolves: Bind a book in dragon hide to evolve into a binder of grimoires.
cost: Your awakened book is jealous of every other book you bind.

requires: Wizard level 5, Rune Sage subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, carve a ward rune into a doorway one stroke per hour for a full day, while the floor's guardians try to break in.
secret: The ward only holds if you carved it with a tool you made yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. The rune holds. Patience is your spell slot.]
blurb: A Rune Sage who perfects the slow inscription, layering runes that grow stronger the longer they stay carved.
features: Skill: Deepening Rune
Each hour a ward rune you carved stays intact, its effect gains +1 to its save DC (max +3).
Skill: Layered Script
You may stack two runes on the same surface, triggering both.
Ultimate: Rune of Ages
Once per long rest, every ward rune you have carved within a mile triggers at once.
evolves: At level 15, maintain a rune for a year to evolve into a sage whose wards protect cities.
cost: Your hands ache from carving; disadvantage on Sleight of Hand.

requires: Wizard level 31, Rune Sage subclass
unlock: On floor 32 of the Shuffled Spire, read the glyphs carved into the tower's shifting walls before each reshuffle scrambles them, and reassemble the sentence.
secret: The sentence only resolves if you read it aloud in the tower's own tongue, which you must learn from the glyphs.
notice: [Hidden job change. You read the tower's script. The Spire knows your name.]
blurb: A Rune Sage who reads the script the Towers themselves are written in, borrowing the excess energy of unclaimed Runes.
features: Skill: Tower Script
Inside any Tower, you can read floor glyphs to learn the floor's trial before it begins.
Skill: Excess Energy
Once per long rest, regain a spell slot of 5th level or lower by drawing on an unclaimed Rune's overflow within 1 mile.
Ultimate: Rewrite the Floor
Once per long rest, rewrite a 60 foot area's rules for 1 minute: choose one condition (no flying, no teleport, no healing) that applies to enemies only.
evolves: Read the First Spire's script to become a sage of Tower law.
cost: Towers notice you; their trials grow harder by one step each time you climb.

requires: Wizard level 11, Rune Sage subclass; Enchanting profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, grind an inkstone from a mirror shard and write a rune that holds its shape in the fog.
secret: The rune only holds if you write it backwards, as the mirror would.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your ink holds in fog. Your runes cling to anything.]
blurb: A Rune Sage who enchants items with slow-script runes, making gear with patient, lasting power.
features: Skill: Rune-Etched
Items you enchant with runes gain +1 Potency and never lose their charge.
Skill: Recall Rune
An item you enchant can restore a spent 1st level slot once per day to its holder.
Ultimate: Grand Inscription
Once per long rest, rune-mark an ally's gear for 1 minute; their attacks deal extra force equal to your Intelligence modifier.
evolves: Enchant an item of Hell or Heaven grade to evolve into a rune master.
cost: Your runes fade if you lie while carving them.

requires: Wizard level 5, School of Abjuration (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, protect a sleeping child with your Arcane Ward through a night of ghost attacks without letting the ward fall.
secret: The ward only holds if you never wake the child.
notice: [Hidden job change. The child slept through it all. Your ward is stronger.]
blurb: An Abjurer who sharpens the Arcane Ward into a wall that can shield a whole party.
features: Skill: Spread Ward
Your Arcane Ward can absorb damage for any ally within 10 feet.
Skill: Hardened Ward
Your Arcane Ward's maximum hit points increase by your Intelligence modifier times 3.
Ultimate: Bastion
Once per long rest, your ward becomes a 20 foot dome for 1 minute; allies inside take no damage until the ward breaks.
evolves: At level 15, ward a hundred allies through a battle to evolve into a sage of bastions.
cost: Your ward feels every blow; you take 1 psychic each time it drops below half.

requires: Wizard level 21, School of Abjuration (Wizard) subclass; carries a fragment of the Shield Rune
unlock: On floor 22 of the Choir Spire, shield a mortal soul from Heaven's judgment through a full trial.
secret: The shield only holds if you believe the soul is guilty.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your shield held against Heaven. The Shield Rune is impressed.]
blurb: An Abjurer who binds a Shield Rune fragment to the Arcane Ward, making a barrier even judgment struggles to pierce.
features: Skill: Rune-Ward
Your Arcane Ward ignores the first 10 damage of each hit.
Skill: Sentinel Watch
You may cast shield as a reaction for allies within 30 feet.
Ultimate: The Unbroken Shield
Once per long rest, your ward becomes unbreakable for 1 round.
evolves: Hold the whole Shield Rune to follow its progenitor.
cost: Your ward cannot tell friend from foe for healing; it blocks healing spells too.

requires: Wizard level 11, School of Abjuration (Wizard) subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, forge a shield and ward it so your own spells cannot pierce it.
secret: The shield only holds if you test it with your strongest spell.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your forge wards as well as it shapes.]
blurb: An Abjurer who forges warded armor and shields, each carrying a fragment of the Arcane Ward.
features: Skill: Warded Steel
Armor and shields you forge carry a small ward (hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier times 2).
Skill: Spell-Turning Shield
Shields you forge give advantage on saves against spells.
Ultimate: Fortress Forging
Once per long rest, everything you forged within 60 feet regains its ward and gains +1 AC for 1 minute.
evolves: Forge armor from Heaven grade silver to evolve into a smith of holy armor.
cost: Warded items reject their wearers' own spells, sometimes.

requires: Wizard level 5, School of Conjuration (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, knock on a painted door a hundred times until something on the other side knocks back, then invite it in politely.
secret: The thing only steps through if you offer it a seat and a cup of something warm.
notice: [Hidden job change. A guest has arrived. Your door opens both ways now.]
blurb: A Conjurer who sharpens summoning into hospitality, calling creatures as guests who fight harder for a good host.
features: Skill: Gracious Host
Creatures you summon gain temporary hit points equal to your wizard level and +1 AC.
Skill: Open Door
Once per short rest, you and a summoned creature swap places as a bonus action.
Ultimate: Full House
Once per long rest, double the number of creatures one conjuration spell summons.
evolves: At level 15, host a hundred summoned guests to evolve into a conjurer whose guests stay a full day.
cost: Guests remember rudeness; if a summon dies by your hand, its kin refuse your next call.

requires: Wizard level 41, School of Conjuration (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 43 of the Sunken Spire, conjure a room that does not exist in any realm and live in it for three days while the Spire tries to drag it down.
secret: The room only holds if you furnish it entirely with conjured objects.
notice: [Hidden job change. A room nowhere belongs to you. Welcome, steward.]
blurb: A Conjurer who builds a small realm of their own, stepping in and out of a place no one else can reach.
features: Skill: Private Room
As an action, open a door to your pocket realm; up to ten creatures can enter, and it is safe from Realm Pressure.
Skill: Steward's Pantry
Your pocket realm stocks food, water and basic gear for the party each day.
Ultimate: Close the Door
Once per long rest, pull an enemy into your pocket realm and seal it for 1 minute (Charisma save).
evolves: Grow your pocket realm to the size of a town to evolve into a lord of a small realm.
cost: If you die, everything in your pocket realm is lost forever.

requires: Wizard level 11, School of Conjuration (Wizard) subclass; Cooking profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, cook a feast from conjured ingredients that does not vanish when the spell ends.
secret: The feast only stays if you season it with salt you carried in from outside.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your conjured food is real. Your kitchen is everywhere.]
blurb: A Conjurer who conjures ingredients from anywhere, cooking meals from foods of other realms.
features: Skill: Far Pantry
Conjure one rare ingredient from another realm per day.
Skill: Realm Meal
Meals you cook grant resistance to one realm's Realm Pressure for 8 hours.
Ultimate: Banquet of Realms
Once per long rest, a feast you cook grants every eater one minor property of a creature you conjure.
evolves: Cook with conjured Primordial ingredients to evolve into a chef of realms.
cost: Conjured food tastes faintly of nothing; no one can tell you why.

requires: Wizard level 5, School of Divination (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, flip a coin a hundred times and call every flip correctly using your Portent alone.
secret: The streak only counts if you bet everything you own on the last flip.
notice: [Hidden job change. The coin obeys your Portent. Fortune sides with you.]
blurb: A Diviner who sharpens Portent into a gambler's knack, adding more futures to their pocket.
features: Skill: Third Portent
Roll three d20s for Portent instead of two.
Skill: Flip Fate
Once per short rest, swap a Portent die with any die rolled within 60 feet.
Ultimate: Rigged Future
Once per long rest, choose the result of every d20 rolled within 30 feet for 1 round.
evolves: At level 15, win a bet with a god of fortune to evolve into a gambler of futures.
cost: Gambling becomes compulsive; you must make a bet each day or take 1d10 psychic.

requires: Wizard level 21, School of Divination (Wizard) subclass; carries a fragment of the Fate Rune
unlock: On floor 23 of the Choir Spire, read the fate of every singer and warn the one destined to fall, without telling anyone else.
secret: The warning only counts if the singer heeds it and the fate is truly changed.
notice: [Hidden job change. A fate has been rewritten. The Fate Rune has noticed the hand that did it.]
blurb: A Diviner who binds a Fate Rune fragment to Portent, reading futures and occasionally editing them.
features: Skill: Fate's Thread
You may hold one Portent die across a long rest; it does not vanish when you roll new ones.
Skill: Turned Fate
Once per long rest, turn a critical hit against an ally into a normal hit, or a normal hit into a miss.
Ultimate: Rewritten Thread
Once per long rest, choose a creature within 60 feet; for 1 round, every d20 it rolls is a 1 or a 20, your choice each time.
evolves: Hold the whole Fate Rune to seek its progenitor.
cost: Seeing fate is heavy: you know the day of your death, and the date moves closer each time you rewrite a thread.

requires: Wizard level 11, School of Divination (Wizard) subclass; Navigation profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, predict where each door will lead before you open it, ten times in a row, then map the route upward.
secret: The map only holds if you open every door yourself and none for the party.
notice: [Hidden job change. You mapped what had not happened yet. The mist cannot fool you.]
blurb: A Diviner who maps possible futures, charting not only where roads go but what waits along them.
features: Skill: Forked Map
Once per day, learn the most dangerous encounter on a route within a day's travel.
Skill: Fortune's Path
Allies travelling by your map gain advantage on initiative and cannot be surprised.
Ultimate: Every Road at Once
Once per long rest, learn the layout and the trial of the next five floors of a Tower or dungeon.
evolves: Map every floor of a Tower before climbing it to become an augur that Towers fear.
cost: Your maps show only bad futures; safe roads stay blank.

requires: Wizard level 5, School of Enchantment (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, a raging bear-beast guards the stairs; sing it to sleep using only charm magic, then sleep beside it until it wakes calm.
secret: The beast only stays calm if you were sung to sleep as a child and remember the song.
notice: [Hidden job change. The beast dreams of you kindly. Your charm has a cradle-song.]
blurb: An Enchanter who sharpens charm into lullabies, calming beasts and dulling the will of foes to fight.
features: Skill: Cradle-Song
Your Hypnotic Gaze can affect two creatures at once and works on creatures that cannot understand you.
Skill: Heavy Eyelids
Creatures charmed by you have disadvantage on saves against sleep and your enchantments.
Ultimate: Dreamless Night
Once per long rest, every creature you choose within 30 feet falls asleep for 1 minute (Wisdom save); damage wakes them.
evolves: At level 15, sing a dragon to sleep and the charmer evolves into one whose songs reach across a valley.
cost: You fall asleep easily yourself: disadvantage on saves against sleep.

requires: Wizard level 21, School of Enchantment (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 22 of the Ledger Spire, two devil houses are at war over a plaque; charm both lords into signing a truce without either knowing they were charmed.
secret: The truce only holds if you add a clause that benefits neither side, only the debtors on the plaque.
notice: [Hidden job change. A truce signed in brass. Hell will remember the envoy.]
blurb: An Enchanter who uses charm as diplomacy, a sworn envoy whose truces even devils hesitate to break.
features: Skill: Brass Words
Fiends and celestials lose any immunity to being charmed against your spells, gaining advantage on the save instead.
Skill: Sworn Truce
Two creatures you charm at once cannot attack each other for 1 hour, even after the charm ends.
Ultimate: The Brass Truce
Once per long rest, declare a truce in a 120 foot radius: every creature must pass a Wisdom save or be unable to attack for 1 minute; any that breaks it takes 10d10 fire.
evolves: Broker a truce between two gods and the class may evolve into an envoy of realms.
cost: Your truces bind you too: you can never attack a creature you have charmed into a truce.

requires: Wizard level 11, School of Enchantment (Wizard) subclass; Alchemy profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, distill a perfume from the mist so sweet that your own reflection steps out of the mirror to follow it.
secret: The perfume only works if you test it on yourself first and resist it.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your reflection followed its nose. Your perfumes enchant.]
blurb: An Enchanter who brews charm into scents and oils, enchantments that work on anyone who breathes.
features: Skill: Courtly Scent
A perfume you brew grants the wearer advantage on Persuasion and Performance for 1 hour.
Skill: Warding Oil
Creatures that smell your oil must pass a Wisdom save to attack its wearer first in a fight.
Ultimate: Bewitching Cloud
Once per long rest, break a flask: every creature within 30 feet is charmed by you for 1 minute (Wisdom save, repeated each turn).
evolves: Brew with Heaven grade blossoms and a goddess of love might commission a scent.
cost: Your sense of smell is gone except for your own perfumes.

requires: Wizard level 5, School of Evocation subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, a hostage sits inside a ring of bandits; drop a fireball on the ring that leaves the hostage's eyebrows unsinged.
secret: The job only triggers if you ask the hostage's permission first, and they say yes.
notice: [Hidden job change. Fire with a needle's point. Your blasts know who to spare.]
blurb: An Evoker who sharpens Sculpt Spells from a rough exception into surgical precision, shaping every blast down to the inch.
features: Skill: Needle Sculpt
Sculpt Spells now protects any number of creatures you can see, and protected allies gain +1 AC until your next turn.
Skill: Focused Burn
When an area spell hits only one creature, it deals an extra 2d8 damage.
Ultimate: The Eye of the Storm
Once per long rest, cast an area spell of 5th level or lower and shape its area into any form that fits inside a 60 foot cube.
evolves: At level 15, sculpt a spell around a hundred allies in one fight and the class evolves into an evoker whose blasts can thread a keyhole.
cost: Precision takes focus; you cannot cast evocations while frightened.

requires: Wizard level 31, School of Evocation subclass; carries a fragment of the Lightning or Storm Rune
unlock: On floor 34 of the Shuffled Spire, catch every bolt of a reshuffling storm floor in your own body, store the charge, and release it all on the floor's guardian.
secret: The charge only stores if you have survived an Overchannel at 9th level before entering.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your body is a battery. The Rune hums under your skin.]
blurb: An Evoker who binds a storm Rune fragment to Overchannel, storing raw power between battles and discharging it all at once.
features: Skill: Stored Charge
Damage from lightning or thunder you take is stored as Charge (max equal to your wizard level times 2), added to your next evocation's damage.
Skill: Safe Overchannel
Overchannel no longer damages you on its second use per long rest.
Ultimate: Total Discharge
Once per long rest, release all stored Charge and your highest slot as a 120 foot line (that slot's level times 3d10 lightning, Dexterity save for half).
evolves: Hold the full Storm Rune to chase its progenitor's lightning.
cost: Stored Charge leaks: metal within 5 feet of you sparks, and you cannot touch water without shocking anyone in it.

requires: Wizard level 11, School of Evocation subclass; Alchemy profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, light up the mist with a firework display so bright that the floor's path is revealed.
secret: The fireworks only reveal the path if one of them spells out your name.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your evocations sparkle. Your craft explodes.]
blurb: An Evoker who bottles evocations into fireworks, bombs and signal flares.
features: Skill: Bottled Blast
Bottle a 1st or 2nd level evocation into a firework that anyone can throw.
Skill: Dazzling Burst
Your fireworks blind creatures caught in them for 1 round (Constitution save).
Ultimate: Grand Finale
Once per long rest, launch a barrage of fireworks (10d6 fire and 10d6 radiant in a 40 foot radius).
evolves: Light up a whole city's sky to evolve into an artisan of the skies.
cost: Your pack is always on the verge of exploding; fire damage to you ignites it.

requires: Wizard level 5, School of Illusion (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 6 of the Milestone Spire, escape a locked room by painting an illusory door so convincing that the tower opens it for you.
secret: The tower only opens the door if you walk through without hesitating.
notice: [Hidden job change. The tower believed your painting. Illusion became real.]
blurb: An Illusionist who sharpens Illusory Reality into a trick of painted doors and walls that briefly become real.
features: Skill: Painted Door
Once per short rest, an illusory door you create becomes real for 1 round.
Skill: Doubtful Walls
Creatures who fail to disbelieve your illusions take 2d8 psychic.
Ultimate: The Real Fake
Once per long rest, make one illusion real for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 15, fool a god with a painted door to evolve into a trickster of realities.
cost: You sometimes forget which of your doors are real.

requires: Wizard level 11, School of Illusion (Wizard) subclass; carries a fragment of the Mirror Realm Rune
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, step into one of the tower's mirrors and convince the mirror world that you are its own reflection.
secret: The mirror world only accepts you if you mimic your reflection without error for one hour.
notice: [Hidden job change. You live in the mirror now, half the time.]
blurb: An Illusionist bound to a Mirror Realm Rune fragment, stepping into reflections and casting illusions from within them.
features: Skill: Mirror Step
Teleport between reflective surfaces within 60 feet as a bonus action.
Skill: Reflected Phantom
Your illusions can be cast from any mirror you can see.
Ultimate: The Mirror Shatters
Once per long rest, shatter a mirror; enemies within 30 feet take 10d8 slashing from phantom glass (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: Hold the whole Mirror Realm Rune and the reflection world may lead you toward its progenitor.
cost: Your reflection sometimes acts on its own, and once a week the DM may have it move, speak or lie for you.

requires: Wizard level 21, School of Illusion (Wizard) subclass; Tailoring profession level 6
unlock: On floor 21 of the Choir Spire, dress the whole choir in illusory robes so beautiful that the angels weep.
secret: The robes only stay if you made one real robe for the conductor.
notice: [Hidden job change. Heaven wears your work.]
blurb: An Illusionist who weaves glamour into cloth, making garments that change appearance at will.
features: Skill: Glamour Weave
Garments you make can change appearance at the wearer's will.
Skill: Dazzling Cloth
Wearers of your garments have advantage on Performance and Deception.
Ultimate: Grand Show
Once per long rest, every ally wearing your work becomes invisible for 1 minute.
evolves: Dress a god for a festival in garments of pure glamour and the class may evolve into a tailor of divine illusion.
cost: Plain cloth now feels dead in your hands: you cannot craft ordinary garments without a DC 15 Tailoring check.

requires: Wizard level 5, School of Necromancy (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 8 of the Milestone Spire, an ossuary's bones have been mixed up; sort every skeleton back into the right person by feel alone before the candles burn out.
secret: The tally only counts if you say each dead person's name aloud as you finish them, learning the names by questioning the skulls.
notice: [Hidden job change. Every bone counted. The dead know you keep good books.]
blurb: A Necromancer who sharpens the craft into careful bookkeeping of the dead, raising fewer servants but far better ones.
features: Skill: Counted Bones
Undead you raise add your proficiency bonus to their damage rolls and gain +1 AC.
Skill: Name the Dead
Speaking a dead creature's name lets you raise it with its old skills (one proficiency or feature it had in life) for 1 hour.
Ultimate: The Tally Stands
Once per long rest, every corpse within 60 feet rises at once as a skeleton or zombie under your command for 1 minute.
evolves: At level 15, keep the ledger of a thousand dead and the tallyman evolves into a necromancer graveyards open their gates for.
cost: The dead keep books too; each servant destroyed in your service adds a whisper you hear at night.

requires: Wizard level 21, School of Necromancy (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 22 of the Ledger Spire, audit a lich's phylactery-contract and find the clause that lets the soul go free.
secret: The audit only closes if you free the soul rather than take it for yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. A soul freed from a lich's ledger. Hell respects a good auditor.]
blurb: A Necromancer who studies the paperwork of undeath in Hell, learning how souls are bound and how to cut them loose.
features: Skill: Bound-Soul Sight
You see the soul-bindings of undead within 120 feet and know who holds each one.
Skill: Cut the Thread
Your necrotic spells sever an undead creature's binding: it loses its master's commands for 1 minute.
Ultimate: Foreclosure
Once per long rest, seize control of up to six undead within 60 feet whose bindings you have seen (Charisma save).
evolves: Audit a lich's phylactery to the last clause to evolve into a necromancer who can unmake liches.
cost: Liches and devils both want the ledgers you carry.

requires: Wizard level 11, School of Necromancy (Wizard) subclass; Scavenging profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, scavenge bones from creatures lost in the mist and weave them into a loom that spins thread from death itself.
secret: The loom only spins if one of its bones is from someone you knew.
notice: [Hidden job change. Death has a thread. Your loom spins it.]
blurb: A Necromancer who scavenges remains and spins necrotic thread, binding undead with stitches.
features: Skill: Death-Thread
Undead you raise from scavenged remains gain resistance to radiant.
Skill: Stitched Servant
Combine two corpses into one undead with both creatures' hit points.
Ultimate: The Loom of Bones
Once per long rest, stitch every corpse within 60 feet into one Huge abomination for 1 minute.
evolves: Scavenge a dragon's bones to evolve into a weaver of undead titans.
cost: The thread follows you; small animals die near your loom.

requires: Wizard level 5, School of Transmutation (Wizard) subclass
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire, turn a lead coin into gold so convincing that the tower's merchant accepts it, then confess and pay with real coin.
secret: The job only triggers if the merchant laughs when you confess.
notice: [Hidden job change. Lead into gold, and honesty into profit.]
blurb: A Transmuter who sharpens minor alchemy into a gift for changing one substance into another at a moment's notice.
features: Skill: Quick Transmute
Minor Alchemy works as a bonus action and lasts 1 hour.
Skill: Soft Steel
Transmute an enemy's armor or weapon into soft lead for 1 round (-2 AC or half damage, Constitution save).
Ultimate: Midas Touch
Once per long rest, turn a creature within 30 feet to gold for 1 minute (Constitution save, petrified).
evolves: At level 15, turn a mountain of lead into gold to evolve into a transmuter kings fear.
cost: Gold you transmute turns back after a day; merchants hunt you.

requires: Wizard level 31, School of Transmutation (Wizard) subclass; carries a fragment of the Change Rune
unlock: On floor 32 of the Shuffled Spire, survive a full reshuffle in a body that changes shape every minute, then find your way back to your own face.
secret: Your body only settles if you choose your original form at the end, even when a stronger one is offered.
notice: [Hidden job change. You changed a hundred times and came back. The Change Rune approves.]
blurb: A Transmuter who binds a Change Rune fragment, transmuting flesh, matter and the ground underfoot at will.
features: Skill: Flesh to Steel
Once per short rest, turn your skin to stone or steel for 1 minute: +2 AC and resistance to nonmagical damage.
Skill: Shifting Resistance
Once per turn, choose one damage type you resist until your next turn.
Ultimate: Total Change
Once per long rest, transmute a 30 foot radius for 1 minute: stone to water, water to air, air to glass; creatures caught take 10d10 damage of a type you choose (Constitution save for half).
evolves: Hold the whole Change Rune to follow its progenitor's trail.
cost: Each time you use Total Change, one small feature of your body (eye colour, a finger, your voice) stays changed for good.

requires: Wizard level 11, School of Transmutation (Wizard) subclass; Blacksmithing profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, forge a blade by transmuting raw stone into steel mid-strike.
secret: The blade only forms if you strike the anvil exactly 100 times.
notice: [Hidden job change. Stone into steel. Your forge transmutes.]
blurb: A Transmuter who forges metal from base materials, turning stone, wood and bone into finer grades.
features: Skill: Raised Grade
Transmute a material to the next grade once per day.
Skill: Living Metal
Weapons you forge can change form once per turn.
Ultimate: Philosopher's Anvil
Once per long rest, transmute a weapon to Hell or Heaven grade for 1 hour.
evolves: Forge with a philosopher's stone to evolve into a smith of perfect metals.
cost: Your transmutations decay if you leave them unattended.

requires: Wizard level 5, Void Scholar subclass
unlock: On floor 10 of the Milestone Spire, a library has one blank book; write a footnote in it describing the Void so precisely that the page vanishes.
secret: The page only vanishes if you cite at least one source you found yourself in a real ruin.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your footnote is so accurate it erased the page. The Void reads your work.]
blurb: A Void Scholar who sharpens study into precise citation, folding small pieces of space with careful notes.
features: Skill: Annotated Fold
Once per short rest, fold space to teleport yourself or an ally 30 feet as a bonus action.
Skill: Cited Unravel
Your counterspell gains +2 when you have studied the spell beforehand.
Ultimate: Erratum
Once per long rest, erase one ongoing spell within 120 feet.
evolves: At level 15, publish a treatise on the Void to evolve into a scholar the Void reads.
cost: Your notes vanish if anyone else reads them.

requires: Wizard level 41, Void Scholar subclass; has visited the Void realm
unlock: On floor 45 of the Sunken Spire, give a lecture on the Void to the things that watch from the stairwells, and keep every one of them listening until you finish.
secret: The audience only stays if you lecture in total darkness and never once raise your voice.
notice: [Hidden job change. The deep took notes. Your lectures now frighten things older than you.]
blurb: A Void Scholar who teaches the deep things of the Abyss about the Void, and finds that knowledge of nothing is a weapon.
features: Skill: Captive Audience
Creatures within 30 feet that can hear you have disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.
Skill: Notes in the Dark
Your spells ignore darkness, blindness and total cover from magical darkness.
Ultimate: The Lesson on Nothing
Once per long rest, deliver a 1 minute lecture: enemies within 60 feet take 10d10 psychic and are frightened for its duration (Wisdom save for half and not frightened).
evolves: Deliver the lecture in the Void itself and something there may ask to be your student.
cost: Things in the deep remember your voice and come up to hear more.

requires: Wizard level 11, Void Scholar subclass; Navigation profession level 4
unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire, draw two distant rooms on one sheet, fold it so they touch, and step from one room into the other.
secret: The fold only holds if you make it with a single crease and never unfold it again.
notice: [Hidden job change. One crease, two places. You survey the folds in the world.]
blurb: A Void Scholar who surveys the creases in space, charting shortcuts that only a folded map can show.
features: Skill: Creased Route
Overland travel between two places you have mapped takes half the time for up to eight companions.
Skill: Map-Door
Once per long rest, step through a fold from one point on your map to another within 1 mile, bringing up to five creatures.
Ultimate: Fold the Field
Once per long rest, fold the battlefield: swap the positions of up to four pairs of creatures within 120 feet (unwilling ones get a Charisma save).
evolves: Fold a map of a whole realm without tearing it and you may chart the creases that lead into the Void.
cost: Every fold you use is permanent on your map; after a hundred, the map becomes too creased to read and must be redrawn from scratch.

requires: Wizard level 5, War Magic subclass
unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire, lead a squad of tower-spawned militia through a mock siege without any of them falling.
secret: The militia only follow you if you stand in the front line yourself.
notice: [Hidden job change. The line held. You are a tactician now.]
blurb: A War Magic wizard who sharpens Arcane Deflection into a line of shields for allies.
features: Skill: Shared Deflection
Use Arcane Deflection on an ally within 10 feet.
Skill: Line Command
As a bonus action, an ally within 30 feet may move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
Ultimate: Hold the Line
Once per long rest, for 1 minute allies within 15 feet gain +2 AC and advantage on saves.
evolves: At level 15, win a real battle in which no ally under your command falls and the class evolves into a tactician of armies.
cost: You cannot willingly retreat while an ally within 60 feet is still fighting; doing so seals the class for a week.

requires: Wizard level 11, War Magic subclass; Engineering profession level 4
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire, build a ballista from the floor's broken furniture and fire a spell from it through the fog to hit a bell you cannot see.
secret: The ballista only fires true if you load it with a spell slot of your highest level, spent willingly.
notice: [Hidden job change. The bell rings through the fog. Your engines fire spells now.]
blurb: A War Magic wizard who builds war machines that throw spells instead of stones, turning a single cast into artillery.
features: Skill: Spell Ballista
Spend 10 minutes to build a ballista; a spell you load into it has double range and adds your Intelligence modifier to its damage.
Skill: Loaded Rack
Your ballista can hold one stored spell of 3rd level or lower, fired by any ally as an action.
Ultimate: Arcane Barrage
Once per long rest, every ballista you have built within 300 feet fires your highest prepared evocation at once, each at a different target, without expending slots.
evolves: Build a siege engine from Hell grade metal and the Ledger Spire will hire you to break its own gates.
cost: Your engines are loud and glowing; enemies always know where your artillery is.

requires: Wizard level 21, War Magic subclass; Minor contract with Indra
unlock: On floor 21 of the Ledger Spire, a devil's legion marches on a single banner; hold that ground for a full day of war, then plant Indra's thunder-banner where theirs stood.
secret: Indra only answers if you never once used Arcane Deflection on yourself during the whole day, only on others.
notice: [Hidden job change. The banner stands. A god of thunder has counted your battles.]
blurb: A War Magic wizard contracted to a thunder god of war, who fights from under a crackling banner that turns a battle line into a storm front.
features: Skill: Banner of Rain and Bolt
Plant a banner (bonus action); while you are within 30 feet of it, allies there add 1d6 lightning to weapon hits and you add your Intelligence modifier to initiative twice.
Skill: Deflecting Thunder
When you use Arcane Deflection, the attacker takes 3d8 thunder and is pushed 10 feet.
Ultimate: The Rain-King's Charge
Once per long rest, the banner calls a storm for 1 minute: each turn, one lightning bolt of your choice strikes a creature within 120 feet (8d10 lightning, Dexterity save for half).
evolves: Win a war that a god has wagered on and Indra may raise the contract to a 2nd Finger.
cost: Indra calls you to his wars without warning, and you must march within a day or lose your spells until you do.
